问题：手工特征占主导，深 CNN 计算昂贵且易饱和或过拟合
Question: Hand-crafted features dominated vision; deep CNNs were computationally prohibitive and prone to saturating gradients or severe overfitting.
机制：GPU 训练的深层卷积分类器，以 ReLU、dropout 和增强扩大可训练规模
Mechanism: End-to-end GPU-trained deep convolutional classifier scaling capacity via ReLU, dropout, and aggressive data augmentation.
问题：网络加深后出现优化退化，训练误差反而上升
Question: Deepening plain networks triggered optimization degradation where training error paradoxically increased with depth.
机制：用恒等捷径学习残差映射 y=x+F(x)
Mechanism: Reformulate layers to learn residual perturbations y = x + F(x) relative to an identity reference.
问题：深层网络中特征传播与梯度传递受阻，并会重复学习相似表示
Question: Deep networks suffered from attenuated feature propagation and redundant re-learning of low-level representations.
机制：每层接收全部前层特征的拼接并以 growth rate 控制宽度
Mechanism: Feed each layer the channel-wise concatenation of all prior layers within a block while bounding width via a fixed growth rate k.
问题：Transformer 与 CNN 的比较混入了训练配方和层级设计差异
Question: Comparisons between Vision Transformers and CNNs conflated self-attention with modern training recipes and macro-architecture design.
机制：以现代训练配方和大核 depthwise 卷积重构纯卷积层级主干
Mechanism: Modernize a pure hierarchical ConvNet using Transformer-era training recipes and large-kernel depthwise convolutions.
问题：分类网络只能给图级标签，逐 patch 推理低效且边界粗
Question: Classification CNNs produced only image-level labels; sliding-window patch classification was redundant and boundary-coarse.
机制：将分类 CNN 的全连接层卷积化，端到端输出像素级预测
Mechanism: Transform fully connected layers into convolutions and append transposed-convolution upsampling for end-to-end pixel-wise training.
问题：FCN 上采样边界粗，生物医学标注稀缺
Question: FCN upsampling lost fine boundary localization, while annotated biomedical datasets were small.
机制：对称 encoder-decoder 与同尺度长跳连联合语义和精确定位
Mechanism: Pair a contracting semantic encoder with a symmetric expanding decoder linked by same-scale feature concatenation skips.
问题：U-Net 跳连把大量背景细节无差别传给 decoder，小器官易被淹没
Question: Unfiltered U-Net skip connections pass cluttered background activations to the decoder, degrading small-organ false-positive rates.
机制：用 decoder gating 信号对 skip 特征做空间注意力筛选
Mechanism: Gate high-resolution encoder skip features spatially using contextual gating signals from the coarser decoder stage.
问题：新数据集依赖大量专家手调，论文比较常被 pipeline 差异混淆
Question: Segmentation performance was dominated by manual per-dataset tuning, confounding architectural comparisons across papers.
机制：根据数据集 fingerprint 自动配置预处理、网络、采样、训练与推理
Mechanism: Automate preprocessing, network topology, patch/batch sizing, sampling, training schedule, and post-processing directly from dataset statistics.
问题：平坦 UNETR token 序列昂贵且缺自然多尺度，3D 标注有限
Question: Flat UNETR tokens lack multi-scale spatial pyramids and scale poorly to high-resolution 3D volumes under limited labels.
机制：层级 shifted-window Transformer 与 U 形解码器结合，并在 5050 个 CT 上自监督预训练
Mechanism: Replace flat ViT with a 3D shifted-window Swin pyramid and pretrain on 5,050 unlabeled volumetric CT scans.
问题：PCA 与手工字典只能表达线性或预设结构
Question: Linear PCA could not capture curved data manifolds, while deep non-linear autoencoders failed to optimize from random initialization.
机制：用深层 encoder-decoder 学非线性低维 latent 并重建输入
Mechanism: Pretrain stacked RBMs greedily layer-by-layer, then unfold into a symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned by backpropagation.
问题：显式 likelihood 生成模型难训练且样本常过度平滑
Question: Pixel-wise L1/L2 and maximum-likelihood generative models averaged over uncertain modes, producing blurry textures.
机制：generator 与 discriminator 进行对抗式分布学习
Mechanism: Pit a generator G against an adversarial discriminator D trained to distinguish real samples from synthesized ones.
问题：GAN min-max 训练不稳、mode coverage 差，VAE 高频模糊
Question: GANs suffered from adversarial instability and mode dropping, while likelihood-based flows and VAEs struggled with sample sharpness.
机制：通过逐步高斯加噪并训练网络在各噪声尺度预测噪声来生成数据
Mechanism: Destroy data structure gradually via a fixed Gaussian diffusion process and learn the reverse Markov transition via stable multi-scale L2 noise regression.
问题：少量投影无法唯一确定患者三维结构；通用生成先验可能与实际观测不一致。
Question: Sparse projections leave unresolved depth; a generative prior may be inconsistent with the observations.
机制：把冻结的三维先验与可微成像观测结合，在推理阶段约束候选体。
Mechanism: Constrain a frozen 3D prior with the differentiable image-formation model at inference.
问题：Transformer 缺少二维图像输入接口，视觉模型长期依赖卷积
Question: Standard Transformers could not directly ingest pixel grids due to quadratic cost, leaving computer vision reliant on CNNs.
机制：把图像切成 patch token 并使用标准 Transformer encoder
Mechanism: Treat non-overlapping 16×16 image patches as sequence tokens and apply a standard isotropic Transformer encoder.
问题：对比学习依赖强增强和大 batch，ViT 预训练计算昂贵
Question: Contrastive SSL depended heavily on hand-crafted view augmentations, while full-token ViT pretraining was computationally expensive.
机制：高比例遮挡图像 patch，仅让重型 encoder 处理可见 token，再轻量重建
Mechanism: Exploit high spatial redundancy in images by dropping 75% of patches before the encoder and reconstructing raw normalized pixels.
问题：监督分类器只能识别固定类别，类别标签表达有限
Question: Closed-set classifiers could not generalize to unseen diagnostic categories or leverage rich free-text clinical descriptions.
机制：双编码器以对称图文对比损失建立开放词汇共享嵌入空间
Mechanism: Train dual image and text encoders jointly on 400M image–text pairs to maximize cosine similarity of true pairs against N²−N negatives.
问题：传统分割绑定固定数据集和标签集，每换目标需重新训练
Question: Traditional segmentation networks were locked to fixed training classes and could not interactively segment arbitrary user-specified targets.
机制：可复用 ViT image encoder 加点、框、mask prompt encoder 与轻量 mask decoder
Mechanism: Amortize heavy image feature extraction once per image, then decode masks in real time (<50 ms) conditioned on flexible spatial prompts.
问题：原 SAM 跨到医学低对比、多模态图像时 zero-shot 波动大
Question: Out-of-the-box natural-image SAM exhibited high variance and boundary leakage on low-contrast, multi-modality medical scans.
机制：在 157 万医学 image-mask pairs 上领域微调 SAM
Mechanism: Fine-tune SAM's image encoder and mask decoder on a massive multi-modality medical corpus using bounding boxes as a reliable spatial prompt.

ZH // 中文原著论述摘要 卷积、attention 与 selective state-space model 分别提供局部空间先验、输入相关的全局交互和长序列状态压缩。医学 AI 的可靠性还取决于监督信号、任务接口、forward model、数据单位和外部验证，不能只由 backbone 名称或参数量判断。 表示与计算： 局部共享卷积适合有限标注和连续解剖；self-attention 直接建立全局 token 关系，但 3D 成本通常近似随 token 数二次增长；Swin 与 Mamba 用窗口层级和状态扫描控制复杂度，同时引入 window、patch 与 scan 方向偏置。 监督与复用： 对比学习、遮挡重建、自蒸馏和影像–报告对齐把复用单位从单任务权重扩展为通用 encoder；objective、患者级去重、数据单位和域外校准决定迁移是否成立。 可信约束： 重建、配准、导航和 2D→3D 必须满足测量、几何、定量与病灶级约束；视觉真实感和低 measurement residual 都不能单独排除 null-space 错误。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTAbstract Convolutions, self-attention, and selective state-space models (SSMs) respectively encode local spatial priors, input-dependent global interactions, and long-horizon state compression. Yet clinical reliability in biomedical AI is equally governed by supervision signals, task interfaces, physical forward models, independent sampling units, and external multi-center validation—never by backbone nomenclature or parameter count alone. Representation & Computation: Locally shared convolutions align naturally with scarce annotations and continuous anatomy; self-attention establishes direct all-pair token interactions in a single layer, but 3D compute and memory scale quadratically with token count O(N²); Swin and Mamba bound complexity via hierarchical windows and selective state scans, trading quadratic cost for windowing, patchification, and scan-direction inductive biases. Supervision & Transferability: Contrastive learning, masked autoencoding, self-distillation, and radiology report alignment expand the unit of reuse from single-task weights to general-purpose foundation encoders; whether transfer succeeds depends on pretraining objectives, patient-level deduplication, sampling units, and out-of-domain calibration. Physics & Trustworthy Constraints: Tomographic reconstruction, deformable registration, surgical navigation, and 2D-to-3D lifting must satisfy measurement consistency, geometric projection, quantitative calibration, and lesion-level fidelity; neither photorealistic texture nor low measurement residual alone can rule out null-space hallucinations.

主报告将全部核心机制与代表架构归纳为 47 个学习树节点：19 个「必须精通」节点覆盖卷积、残差、U-Net/nnU-Net、注意力、SSL、物理展开重建与可微配准；21 个「需要理解」节点覆盖现代混合骨干、可提示分割、医学 VLM 与扩散/流匹配；7 个「知道即可」节点追踪快速演化前沿。

All foundational mechanisms and landmark architectures are organized into 47 competency nodes: 19 Tier-I (Must-Master) nodes covering convolutions, residual paths, U-Net/nnU-Net, self-attention, SSL, unrolled physics reconstruction, and differentiable registration; 21 Tier-II (Deep-Comprehension) nodes covering modern hybrid backbones, promptable segmentation, medical VLMs, and diffusion/flow matching; and 7 Tier-III (Frontier-Awareness) nodes tracking emerging paradigms.

ZH // 中文原著论述三条主干演化逻辑 架构主干 AlexNet/VGG/Inception → ResNet/DenseNet → EfficientNet/ConvNeXt；同时 CNN → ViT/Swin → S4/Mamba。ConvNeXt/MedNeXt 与 MambaVision 提示长期结果更可能是局部卷积、层级结构和全局 mixer 的混合。 医学分割主干 FCN → U-Net/3D U-Net/V-Net → skip/attention 变体 → nnU-Net → UNETR/Swin UNETR → MedNeXt/U-Mamba → promptable 3D foundation segmentation。范式节点少于网络名称；多数 U-Net 小改不是换代。 生成与重建主干 image mapping/GAN → algorithm unrolling + data consistency → diffusion posterior → latent/DiT → flow matching/consistency + multi-operator prior。真正的进步标准是测量、解剖、定量与临床任务一致，而非只看视觉真实感。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTThree Primary Evolutionary Lineages 01 // Representation Backbones AlexNet / VGG / Inception → ResNet / DenseNet → EfficientNet / ConvNeXt, alongside CNN → ViT / Swin → S4 / Mamba. Modern pure ConvNets (ConvNeXt, MedNeXt) and hybrid architectures (MambaVision) demonstrate that the long-term equilibrium in biomedical vision is a synthesis of local convolutional priors, multi-scale hierarchy, and global token mixers. 02 // Dense Prediction & Medical Segmentation FCN → U-Net / 3D U-Net / V-Net → Skip & Attention Variants → nnU-Net → UNETR / Swin UNETR → MedNeXt / U-Mamba → Promptable 3D Foundation Segmentation. True paradigm shifts are far rarer than named network variants; the vast majority of incremental U-Net block modifications do not constitute generational leaps. 03 // Generative Priors & Physics-Informed Reconstruction Image Mapping / GAN → Algorithm Unrolling + Data Consistency → Diffusion Posterior Sampling → Latent / DiT → Flow Matching / Consistency + Multi-Operator Priors. Authentic progress is measured by joint consistency across raw measurements, anatomy, quantitative biomarkers (HU/SUV/ADC), and downstream clinical decisions—not visual sharpness alone.

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTThree-Layer System Architecture of Biomedical AI A complete biomedical AI system decomposes into: Acquisition / Measurement → Representation Backbone → Task Interface → Physical or Geometric Correction → Calibration & Human Audit. Convolutions, attention, and Mamba primarily alter representation compute; MAE, DINO, and CLIP transform supervision sources and transfer mechanics; U-Net, SAM, and VLMs redefine task interfaces; MoDL, VarNet, and differentiable DRR embed physical measurement and geometric operators directly back into the computation graph.

ZH // 中文原著论述医学转化的核心判断 Transformer 没有取代 CNN：有限医学数据、极长 3D token、小病灶和 spacing 异质性使局部归纳偏置仍有优势。 nnU-Net 的启示比多数新 block 更深：预处理、空间配置、采样、增强、loss、推理和外部验证常比换模块更重要。 SAM/MedSAM 当前最可信角色是交互分割、标注和专科适配，不是无需提示的自动分割终点。 医学 VLM 的语言流畅度不等于图像诊断正确；报告生成应有 grounding、provenance 和人工复核。 重建、配准和 2D→3D 必须把 forward operator、geometry 与 null-space 风险放进方法与评价。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTCore Tenets of Clinical Translation Transformers have not obsoleted CNNs: Under finite medical cohorts, ultra-long 3D token sequences, subtle micro-lesions, and heterogeneous voxel spacing, local convolutional inductive biases remain highly competitive. nnU-Net teaches a deeper lesson than most novel blocks: Preprocessing, anisotropic spacing rules, patch sampling, data augmentation, loss formulation, sliding-window inference, and external validation routinely outweigh isolated module swaps. SAM and MedSAM excel at interactive human-in-the-loop workflows: Their most credible clinical role is annotation acceleration, interactive boundary refinement, and specialist adaptation—not unprompted autonomous segmentation. Linguistic fluency in medical VLMs does not equal diagnostic truth: Automated radiology report generation requires spatial grounding, source provenance, and clinician sign-off. Reconstruction, registration, and 2D-to-3D lifting must model physics: Forward operators, projection geometry, and null-space uncertainty must be explicitly integrated into both architecture design and evaluation.

ZH // 中文原著论述范围与证据等级 范围： 2012-01-01 至 2026-08-29；覆盖 CT、MRI、CBCT、PET、X-ray、超声、病理、眼底、ECG、EEG、PPG 与 EMG，以及分类、检测、分割、配准、姿态、重建、去噪、生成、2D↔3D、跨模态和时序任务。 证据等级： E1 为机制原论文；E2 为医学方法验证；E3 为独立、多中心、读者或前瞻工作流证据；E4 为主要依赖预印本或作者内测的前沿结果。 数据单位： patient、study、volume、series、slice、patch、mask 与 WSI 不能互换；训练规模和数据划分必须按真实独立单位解释。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTScoping Review Coverage & Evidence Hierarchy Temporal & Modality Scope: January 1, 2012 through August 29, 2026; spanning CT, MRI, CBCT, PET, X-ray, Ultrasound, Computational Pathology (WSI), Fundus/OCT, ECG, EEG, PPG, and EMG across classification, detection, segmentation, registration, pose estimation, tomographic reconstruction, denoising, synthesis, 2D-to-3D lifting, multimodal fusion, and physiological time-series modeling. Evidence Grading (E1–E4): E1 denotes foundational mechanism papers; E2 denotes domain-specific medical methodology validation; E3 denotes independent, multi-center, reader-study, or prospective clinical workflow evidence; E4 denotes emerging frontier preprints or internal author benchmarks. Statistical Granularity: patient, study, volume, series, slice, patch, mask, and WSI are non-interchangeable denominators; training scale and evaluation splits must be audited at the true independent patient/study level.

The operator y_o(p)=Σ_iΣ_δ W_{o,i,δ}x_i(p+δ)+b_o simultaneously enforces local connectivity, spatial weight sharing, approximate translation equivariance, and hierarchical composition. The expressive power of Attention lies in input-dependent affinity matrices. Swin restores near-linear scaling via local windows, shifted window partitioning, and patch merging, but introduces window size, hierarchy depth, and anisotropic voxel spacing as sensitive hyperparameters. Mamba compresses history into a finite state rather than materializing an N×N matrix. EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTU-Net Endures Through Information Topology; nnU-Net Prevails Through Holistic System Engineering FCN converted classification CNNs into end-to-end dense predictors via fully convolutional heads and learned upsampling; U-Net resolved the fundamental tension between semantic recognition ("what") and spatial localization ("where") through a symmetric encoder–decoder coupled with same-scale concatenation long skips. Downsampling in the encoder expands semantic context, upsampling in the decoder restores coordinate resolution, and long skips directly transmit sharp edges, small vessels, and anatomical boundaries. Because shallow appearance features and deep semantic representations exhibit a semantic gap, U-Net++ nested dense skips and Attention U-Net spatial gates filter or align skip features prior to fusion—offering practical engineering gains without altering the core dense prediction paradigm. 3D U-Net and V-Net generalized kernels, pooling, elastic augmentations, and Dice-family objectives to volumetric data, capturing native 3D organ continuity at the expense of activation memory, restricted patch field-of-view, and anisotropic slice spacing. While Dice loss mitigates extreme foreground sparsity, it cannot alone guarantee boundary Hausdorff accuracy, topological genus preservation, or small-lesion recall. nnU-Net went further by deriving normalization, resampling spacing, patch/batch configuration, 2D/3D/cascade topology, foreground oversampling, data augmentation, test-time augmentation, and connected-component post-processing directly from a dataset fingerprint—codifying tacit expert heuristics into a reproducible scientific baseline. Any newly proposed segmentation architecture must therefore outperform nnU-Net ResEnc and MedNeXt under identical preprocessing, training budgets, and external multi-center cohorts. Promptable segmentation reshaped the task interface itself. SAM and MedSAM decouple image encoding from point, box, or mask prompts; VISTA3D unifies 127-class automated 3D anatomical priors, 3D point prompts, and novel-structure zero-shot refinement within a single volumetric interface. Their highest-evidence clinical deployment today lies in interactive annotation acceleration, human-in-the-loop correction, and specialist fine-tuning rather than autonomous zero-prompt diagnosis.

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTFoundation Models Are Defined by Supervision Signals and Reuse Interfaces, Not Parameter Count Contrastive learning (SimCLR, MoCo) uses InfoNCE to pull augmented views of the same instance together while pushing other instances apart; in medicine, success hinges not on copying natural-image RGB crops or flips, but on defining transformations that preserve pathological semantics while preventing same-patient or longitudinal scans from becoming false negatives. DINO and DINOv2 combine EMA teacher self-distillation with curated data governance to learn dense local correspondence alongside global semantics; while self-attention maps aid visual inspection, they do not constitute causal explanations. CLIP aligns images and text in a shared contrastive embedding space for retrieval, zero-shot classification, and linear probing, yet global embeddings lack fine-grained spatial localization. GLoRIA and BioViL strengthen local phrase grounding via region–word attention and radiology-specific language modeling (CXR-BERT). Connector-based MLLMs (BLIP-2, LLaVA-Med, MAIRA) bridge frozen vision encoders to LLMs via Q-Formers or MLP projectors, lowering adaptation cost but introducing the risk that strong autoregressive language priors override visual evidence—producing fluent templated narratives that hallucinate or miss subtle lesions. Downstream adaptation must match cohort size and clinical risk: linear probing audits intrinsic representation quality; full fine-tuning maximizes ceiling performance but overfits on small cohorts; adapters and LoRA streamline multi-institutional version control; visual prompts, SAM spatial prompts, and CLIP text prompts serve fundamentally distinct operational interfaces. Regardless of parameter efficiency, PEFT cannot repair patient-level data leakage, scanner domain shift, missing modalities, or miscalibration.

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTThe Challenge of 3D Volumetric AI Is Managing Physical Field-of-View and Activation Memory, Not Replacing Conv2d with Conv3d 2D networks readily leverage ImageNet or 2D foundation encoders with large batch sizes, suiting highly anisotropic thick-slice acquisitions and rapid baselines; 2.5D stacks adjacent slices or tri-planar views for local inter-slice context; native 3D networks directly model volumetric morphology, but scale kernel parameters from k² C_{in} C_{out} to k³ C_{in} C_{out} and, crucially, must store high-resolution encoder skip activations in GPU memory for backpropagation. A 256³ volume contains ≈16.8M voxels versus ≈262K pixels in a 512² slice—a 64\times raw grid expansion that dictates memory ceilings long before parameter count does. Volumetric engineering must begin from physical voxel spacing (mm): thick-slice scans warrant early anisotropic kernels/strides or hybrid 2D/3D designs, whereas blind resampling to isotropic grids fabricates interpolated artifacts. Patch-based training must log physical patch coverage (in mm³), foreground oversampling ratios, and boundary padding; sliding-window inference requires Gaussian-weighted overlap stitching and whole-volume consistency audits. 证据边界： 仍是低数据序列基线；串行训练慢且长窗口扩展有限
EVIDENCE: Reliable low-data sequential baseline; sequential step-by-step recurrence prevents parallel training across ultra-long multi-thousand-sample waveforms.
证据边界： 思想基础；普通 AE 的采样、不确定性和 L2 模糊有限
EVIDENCE: Historical foundation; deterministic L2 autoencoders blur high-frequency details and lack a tractable generative sampling density.
证据边界： 历史里程碑；不再是医学强基线
EVIDENCE: Historical milestone; superseded as a competitive medical backbone.
证据边界： 历史基础；mode collapse、训练不稳和 hallucination 风险突出
EVIDENCE: Foundational generative paradigm; training instability, mode collapse, and anatomically unfaithful hallucinations pose severe clinical risks.
证据边界： 仍是轻量时序基线；串行计算和超长依赖能力弱于现代并行模型
EVIDENCE: Lightweight recurrent baseline; like LSTM, remains bottlenecked by sequential step-by-step training on ultra-long sequences.
证据边界： 范式基础；具体结构已被更强解码器替代
EVIDENCE: Foundational dense-prediction paradigm; asymmetric score-only upsampling is superseded by symmetric U-Net decoders.
证据边界： 领域基础设施；必须从零实现和保留为强基线
EVIDENCE: Cornerstone domain infrastructure; mandatory to master from scratch and retain as a primary baseline.
证据边界： 基础设施；本身不保证变换平滑、可逆或物理合理
EVIDENCE: Essential differentiable geometry primitive; requires explicit regularization when generalized from low-DOF affine to dense displacement fields.
证据边界： 历史主干与表征参照；参数量大、缺残差连接，现已少作首选
EVIDENCE: Historical reference and perceptual loss extractor; heavy FC parameters and lack of residual paths limit modern primary use.
证据边界： 多尺度设计仍重要；原始模块已被更简洁的残差和层级结构取代
EVIDENCE: Multi-scale branching remains influential, though complex hand-tuned Inception topologies are largely superseded by residual/ConvNeXt blocks.
证据边界： 仍是必须精通的强主干和公平对照
EVIDENCE: Mandatory foundational backbone and fair baseline across 2D and 3D biomedical tasks.
证据边界： 经典 3D 基线；显存、patch context 与各向异性仍是瓶颈
EVIDENCE: Canonical 3D baseline; bounded by GPU activation memory, patch field-of-view, and anisotropic slice spacing.
证据边界： 经典强基线；并非唯一 3D 默认网络
EVIDENCE: Classic 3D baseline; Dice loss alone remains insensitive to boundary Hausdorff outliers and topological breaks.
证据边界： 历史恢复基线；缺显式成像物理与现代注意力建模
EVIDENCE: Historically influential in low-dose CT denoising; purely image-domain L2 training can still over-smooth low-contrast liver lesions.
证据边界： 结构思想仍有价值，但 activation memory 较大
EVIDENCE: Enduring architectural principle, though channel concatenation incurs high GPU activation memory in 3D.
证据边界： 基础设施级方法；高分辨 3D 仍受 O(N²) 限制
EVIDENCE: Universal deep learning infrastructure; direct application to dense 3D voxels is bottlenecked by O(N²) attention complexity.
证据边界： 强 mapping 基线；不保证测量一致，可能生成逼真但错误结构
EVIDENCE: Strong paired image-translation baseline; remains an image-domain mapping without physical sensor consistency guarantees.
证据边界： 探索与 style transfer 仍有用；cycle 不保证解剖或定量值保持
EVIDENCE: Useful for exploratory domain adaptation, but cycle consistency is under-constrained and can hallucinate or erase lesions when pathology prevalence differs across domains.
证据边界： 历史与实用价值高；推理后无 projection data consistency
EVIDENCE: High practical speed and historical impact, but enforces zero projection-domain data consistency at inference—risking hallucinated or smoothed subtle lesions.
证据边界： 基础设施级 baseline；原版 AWGN 与 BatchNorm 假设不匹配真实医学噪声
EVIDENCE: Foundational restoration baseline; i.i.d. AWGN assumptions fail on spatially correlated CT sinogram streaks or Poisson PET noise without domain adaptation.
证据边界： GNN 基础；深层 over-smoothing 与构图泄漏需警惕
EVIDENCE: Core GNN baseline; stacking many GCN layers causes over-smoothing, and transductive patient-similarity graphs risk severe cohort leakage.
证据边界： grouped convolution 已成现代 CNN 基础构件；原始主干不是当前唯一强基线
EVIDENCE: Grouped/depthwise convolution is now a permanent staple of modern CNNs.
证据边界： normalizing flow 基础；coupling 表达受限且高维似然未必对应临床异常
EVIDENCE: Foundational normalizing flow; coupling layers require deep stacking for expressivity and raw pixel likelihoods often mis-score semantic OOD anomalies.
证据边界： 归纳 GNN 基础；邻居采样和构图偏差会直接影响医学结论
EVIDENCE: Essential scalable inductive GNN; uniform random neighbor sampling can miss rare diagnostic hub cells if degree distributions are skewed.
证据边界： 仍值得复现；3D projector、operator mismatch 与内存是限制
EVIDENCE: Strong measurement-consistent baseline; requires storing K stages of 2D/3D activations during backpropagation and accurate projector calibration.
证据边界： unrolled MRI 的核心祖型；序列与厂商迁移仍有限
EVIDENCE: Foundational clinical unrolled MRI milestone; shallow Fields-of-Experts regularizers were later deepened into U-Net cascades in E2E-VarNet.
证据边界： 长期有用；独立性、运动和 uptake mismatch 会造成目标偏差
EVIDENCE: Enduring mathematical principle; breaks down if inter-scan patient motion occurs or if noise realizations share correlated bias.
证据边界： 重要图模型；attention 权重不自动等于医学解释
EVIDENCE: Standard anisotropic GNN; learned attention weights α_{ij} aid inspection but do not guarantee causal biological importance.
证据边界： 长期实用；感受野由 dilation/depth 固定且全局自适应关系有限
EVIDENCE: Practical first-line waveform baseline; receptive field is fixed by network depth/dilation and weights remain static across inputs.
证据边界： 通道注意力经典模块；解释性有限，空间定位仍需其他机制
EVIDENCE: Canonical channel-attention module; provides global channel weighting rather than spatial localization.
证据边界： 注意力门控仍实用；提升通常依赖数据、损失和基线配置
EVIDENCE: Practical and lightweight spatial gating module, though improvements depend heavily on loss and pipeline setup.
证据边界： 历史强基线；现代 patch-based 3D 与自动配置框架通常更易复现
EVIDENCE: Historically strong hybrid design; modern patch-based 3D nnU-Net and MedNeXt pipelines offer simpler reproducibility.
证据边界： 历史里程碑；全连接层参数巨大、算子迁移和物理一致性较弱
EVIDENCE: Historical curiosity rather than a scalable baseline: O(N⁴) fully connected parameters cannot scale to clinical 512²/3D grids and discard known Fourier/Radon physics.
证据边界： 仍具方法论价值；固定几何和训练分布限制跨扫描器泛化
EVIDENCE: Methodologically important unrolled CT baseline; fixed system matrices and stage-specific parameters require significant memory.
证据边界： 经典 flow 架构；内存与似然语义问题限制临床直接应用

证据边界： 医学 X-ray 合成基础设施；仿真质量仍取决于扫描与设备标定

证据边界： 基础设施级方法；依赖 operator/coil maps 且迭代计算较重

证据边界： 方法基础重要；空间相关噪声和孤立病灶可能被错误去除

证据边界： 基础设施级 baseline；跨域、相似度选择和 folding 仍是问题

证据边界： 重要但不唯一；逼真纹理不等于患者真实 anatomy

证据边界： 仍是效率基线；高分辨率 3D 医学任务的内存瓶颈需另行处理
EVIDENCE: Strong 2D efficiency baseline; depthwise separable kernels and high resolution require separate activation-memory audits in 3D.
证据边界： 自监督去噪经典方法；结构化噪声和相关噪声会违反假设
EVIDENCE: Classic self-supervised denoiser; structured/correlated noise violates pixel-wise independence and gets preserved as signal.
证据边界： 对比学习基础；医学增强和正负样本定义必须重设
EVIDENCE: Foundational contrastive SSL paradigm; requires large batch sizes and careful medical augmentation design to avoid false negatives.
证据边界： 经典实现；其 momentum/EMA teacher 思想被后续方法继承，queue 本身并非统一模板

证据边界： 长期价值已证明；前瞻证据不等同于公开 VarNet 本身，且显存、采样 mask 和厂商域移位仍需验证

证据边界： 生成建模基础设施；原始数百至千步采样不适合常规部署
EVIDENCE: Core generative infrastructure; standard 1,000-step ancestral sampling is too slow for real-time clinical workflows without acceleration.
证据边界： 场表示基础；原始可见光 alpha-compositing 不能直接当 X-ray 物理
EVIDENCE: Foundational neural field paradigm; visible-light occlusion/emission rendering must be rewritten into Beer–Lambert transmission for X-ray/CT.
证据边界： 医学分割经典变体；复杂跳连的增益需与 nnU-Net 等强基线公平比较

证据边界： 非对比 SSL 经典方法；增强策略与域内多样性对医学迁移至关重要
EVIDENCE: Classic non-contrastive SSL framework; requires careful normalization and domain-valid augmentations.
证据边界： 聚类式 SSL 重要路线；prototype 数量与采样偏差需谨慎控制
EVIDENCE: Foundational clustering-based SSL method; multi-crop strategy became standard in DINO and DINOv2.
证据边界： 经典 coarse-to-fine 学习式基线；可逆性与拓扑保持仍需额外约束
EVIDENCE: Classic multi-scale registration architecture; subsequent GradICON/uniGradICON offer stronger inverse-consistency guarantees.
证据边界： 医学 mesh 深度学习代表；固定拓扑难处理孔洞和复杂拓扑变化
EVIDENCE: Strong explicit 3D surface baseline; fixed sphere topology cannot model organs with holes or variable branching without template modification.
证据边界： 在适用的数据与任务设置下，是新分割方法应比较的必做基线
EVIDENCE: Mandatory first-line baseline against which any newly proposed segmentation architecture must be benchmarked.
证据边界： 奠基价值明确；当前与 MAE、自蒸馏等目标并存或被后者补充
EVIDENCE: Foundational 3D SSL milestone; now complemented by masked autoencoding (MAE) and self-distillation.

EVIDENCE: Excels under massive pretraining (MAE, DINOv2, CLIP); underperforms CNNs when trained from scratch on small medical cohorts.
证据边界： 层级 Transformer 长期有价值；窗口与 patch 尺度仍是新超参数
EVIDENCE: Enduring hierarchical Transformer standard; window size and anisotropic voxel spacing require careful tuning.
证据边界： DINOv2 的直接祖先；机制与 collapse 控制仍必须理解

证据边界： 医学 VLM 基础设施；global embedding、false negatives 与校准仍有限

证据边界： 开启医学 local grounding 主线；attention map 不等于因果解释

证据边界： 部署研究必需；大步长离散误差会先损害细小结构
EVIDENCE: Essential deployment accelerator; overly coarse step strides first degrade fine anatomical vessels and micro-calcifications.
证据边界： 核心数学基础；posterior 与采样仍受 score/likelihood mismatch 影响
EVIDENCE: Foundational mathematical framework; practical medical inverse solving still depends on accurate likelihood score approximations.
证据边界： 训练 recipe 影响巨大；医学域仍需领域预训练与严格外部验证
EVIDENCE: Established standard ViT training recipes; in-domain medical SSL pretraining still outperforms purely supervised recipes.
证据边界： 奠定层级视觉 Transformer；后续 Swin、MiT 等结构更常用
EVIDENCE: Pioneered pyramid Vision Transformers; often succeeded by Swin or SegFormer (MiT) in recent pipelines.
证据边界： 强通用密集预测基线；3D 体数据仍需专门内存设计
EVIDENCE: Strong 2D dense-prediction baseline; extending sequence-reduced attention to 3D still requires careful memory engineering.
证据边界： 规模化 VLM 里程碑；原论文不是医学验证，医学隐私、噪声和临床语义错配更突出
EVIDENCE: Web-scale VLM milestone; in clinical medicine, uncurated label/report noise and privacy leakage require far stricter governance.
证据边界： 强恢复 backbone；未显式保证数据一致性或病灶保真
EVIDENCE: Strong modern restoration backbone; remains an image-space mapping unless embedded inside an unrolled physics data-consistency loop.
证据边界： 少视图 NeRF 基础；自然图像辐射假设不能直接替代医学投影物理
EVIDENCE: Foundational few-view conditional neural field; projective feature occlusion must be adapted for transmission X-ray imaging.
证据边界： 图 Transformer 代表；O(N²) 成本和拓扑构造限制大医学图扩展
EVIDENCE: Leading Graph Transformer; O(N²) all-pair attention and shortest-path computation prohibit direct application to 100,000-node WSI cell graphs.
证据边界： 现代强 CNN 主干，适合公平架构比较
EVIDENCE: State-of-the-art pure CNN backbone ideal for controlled architectural ablations.
证据边界： 重要范式节点；从头训练和二次注意力成本明显
EVIDENCE: Important hybrid milestone, though flat 3D patch attention incurs high quadratic compute and data hunger from scratch.
证据边界： 预训练时有价值；同配方从头训练未必优于现代 CNN
EVIDENCE: Valuable when leveraging pretrained weights; from-scratch training under matched recipes does not consistently beat modern 3D CNNs.
证据边界： 现代 SSM 的数学基础；并行训练常为近 O(N log N) 的长卷积路径，递推推理可线性扩展
EVIDENCE: Foundational structured SSM; linear time-invariant (LTI) dynamics lack content-dependent selection until Mamba.
证据边界： 任务接口影响持久；3D、小目标和 matching 稳定性仍是门槛
EVIDENCE: Influential universal task interface; 3D memory scaling, tiny lesions, and bipartite matching stability remain challenging.
证据边界： 基础设施级 SSL；像素重建可能偏重低层强度
EVIDENCE: Core SSL infrastructure; pixel-level MSE emphasizes fine texture and intensity, shining brightest under downstream fine-tuning.
证据边界： 重要训练思想；常与 DINO 系目标组合使用
EVIDENCE: Highly effective dense + global SSL objective; standardly deployed in tandem with DINOv2 recipes.
证据边界： 医学图文对齐 landmark；局部定位能力有限
EVIDENCE: Landmark medical VLM foundation; global pooling captures study-level semantics but remains coarse for tiny focal lesions.
证据边界： 证明文本建模不是附属模块；模态范围仍以 CXR 为主
EVIDENCE: Proved that clinical text modeling is as critical as visual architecture; scope is primarily specialized to chest radiography.
证据边界： 现实的大模型路线；autoencoder ceiling 可能丢微钙化、小血管和定量强度
EVIDENCE: Pragmatic scaling route; the frozen first-stage autoencoder sets an upper bound on fidelity and can bottleneck tiny micro-lesions or quantitative HU values.
证据边界： inverse solver 重要节点；大规模 CT 的 SVD 和非线性 likelihood 不便
EVIDENCE: Important zero-shot inverse solver milestone; computing explicit full SVD is intractable for large 3D cone-beam CT or non-linear forward operators.
证据边界： 正确的医学 NeRF 改写；无外部 prior 时仍不能创造缺失信息
EVIDENCE: Correct physics adaptation of NeRF to tomography; without an external population prior, extreme view sparsity still exhibits null-space streaks.
证据边界： MIM 关键里程碑；tokenizer 偏差和预训练数据覆盖仍决定上限

CNN Backbones
局部连接、权重共享和层级下采样构成 CNN 的核心空间先验。残差路径改善深层优化，大核与 depthwise 结构扩大有效视野，通道重标定改变特征选择；医学迁移中的稳定收益还依赖归一化、数据规模和训练配方。

Local connectivity, spatial weight sharing, and hierarchical downsampling form the foundational inductive prior of CNNs. Residual identity paths resolve deep optimization degradation, large depthwise kernels expand effective receptive fields, and channel recalibration refines feature selection; stable medical transfer further depends on normalization choices, cohort scale, and modern training recipes.

Medical Translation: Catalyzed transfer of generic ImageNet CNN representations across 2D medical imaging classification and detection.
适用边界：历史里程碑；不再是医学强基线
Evidence Boundary: Historical milestone; superseded as a competitive medical backbone.

Dense Segmentation
分割网络同时处理语义、坐标、边界和小结构。Encoder 压缩上下文，decoder 恢复空间分辨率，long skip 传递定位信息，loss 处理前景稀疏，pipeline 决定物理尺度；nnU-Net 将架构、spacing、patch、采样和推理策略纳入同一系统。

Medical segmentation networks must simultaneously resolve high-level semantics, continuous coordinates, sharp boundaries, and sparse micro-structures. Encoders compress context, decoders restore spatial resolution, long skips preserve localization, overlap losses counter extreme foreground imbalance, and system pipelines govern physical voxel scaling—culminating in nnU-Net's automated end-to-end configuration.
医学适配：是 U-Net 等医学 encoder-decoder 分割网络的直接祖先

状态空间与 Mamba：长程传播、扫描偏置和 3D 代价
State Space & Mamba
SSM 通过隐藏状态递推传播长程信息，Mamba 使状态更新依赖当前输入，从而避免显式构造 N×N 注意力矩阵。医学 2D/3D 中的 raster、双向、四向或轴向扫描会改变空间归纳偏置；线性 token 复杂度不等于边界质量、域外稳健性或临床优势。

State-space models propagate long-range context through recurrent hidden states, while Mamba makes state transitions input-selective to avoid materializing quadratic N×N attention matrices. In 2D/3D medical imaging, raster, bi-directional, four-way, or tri-axial scan serializations alter spatial inductive biases; linear token complexity does not automatically translate into superior boundary precision or clinical robustness.
医学适配：为长 EEG 与波形提供直接机制基础，也启发后续 3D 序列适配
Medical Translation: Provides the mathematical foundation for long-horizon EEG, ECG, waveform modeling, and subsequent visual/3D SSMs.
适用边界：现代 SSM 的数学基础；并行训练常为近 O(N log N) 的长卷积路径，递推推理可线性扩展
Evidence Boundary: Foundational structured SSM; linear time-invariant (LTI) dynamics lack content-dependent selection until Mamba.
医学适配：吸引 3D 分割、长生理信号和视频作为低成本全局 mixer
Medical Translation: Adopted across 3D volumetric segmentation, gigapixel WSI, and long physiological waveforms as a linear-complexity global mixer.
适用边界：序列领域重要；医学中尚无普遍替代 CNN/Transformer 的证据

医学适配：作为医学 2D SSM 的视觉初始化和对照；原生 3D 仍需改造扫描与层级结构
Medical Translation: Serves as the primary 2D vision SSM backbone and initialization for medical 2D segmentation and classification.
适用边界：重要视觉 SSM 基线；未普遍淘汰 ConvNeXt/Swin
Evidence Boundary: Important visual SSM baseline; native 3D volumetric extension requires tri-axial or multi-directional scan adaptations.
医学适配：覆盖多类 2D/3D 医学分割任务
Medical Translation: Evaluated across multi-organ CT, MRI, and endoscopy segmentation benchmarks.
适用边界：高热度研究基线；后续统一配方消融未发现稳定的 Mamba 独立增益
Evidence Boundary: High-visibility hybrid baseline, though subsequent controlled ablations show matched MedNeXt / nnU-Net ResEnc often perform comparably.
医学适配：代表同行评议的 medical Mamba 3D 分割路线

适用边界：值得复现；仍缺统一配方、多中心和边界/小病灶证据
Evidence Boundary: Worth reproducing as a 3D SSM reference; still requires broader multi-center and boundary-level validation.
视觉 Transformer：全局交互、层级窗口与高分辨率代价
Vision Transformers
Self-attention 用 Q/K/V 让 token 按内容选择其他 token，最短全局交互路径为一层，但时间和显存通常随 token 数近似二次增长。ViT 强调纯 token 化，DeiT 强调训练配方，PVT 与 Swin 引入金字塔、局部窗口和下采样以支持检测与分割。

Self-attention uses Q/K/V projections so every token dynamically queries all other tokens with O(1) path length, at the cost of quadratic O(N²) time and memory scaling. ViT establishes pure patch tokenization, DeiT refines data-efficient distillation recipes, and PVT/Swin introduce multi-scale pyramids and shifted local windows to support dense detection and segmentation.
医学适配：是 ViT、医学 VLM、长生理信号模型的共同基础
Medical Translation: Foundational operator underlying Vision Transformers, medical VLMs, multimodal EHR fusion, and biosignal foundation models.
适用边界：基础设施级方法；高分辨 3D 仍受 O(N²) 限制
Evidence Boundary: Universal deep learning infrastructure; direct application to dense 3D voxels is bottlenecked by O(N²) attention complexity.
医学适配：成为医学 foundation encoder 主流，但 3D 和小病灶需更细致 token 化
Medical Translation: Dominant backbone for large-scale self-supervised pathology (UNI, Virchow) and multimodal medical foundation models.
适用边界：大规模预训练时强；小数据从头训练不一定优于 CNN
Evidence Boundary: Excels under massive pretraining (MAE, DINOv2, CLIP); underperforms CNNs when trained from scratch on small medical cohorts.
医学适配：广泛用于 2D/3D 医学分割、检测和 Swin UNETR
Medical Translation: Core backbone for Swin UNETR, TransMorph, MARS, and high-resolution 2D/3D medical dense prediction.
适用边界：层级 Transformer 长期有价值；窗口与 patch 尺度仍是新超参数
Evidence Boundary: Enduring hierarchical Transformer standard; window size and anisotropic voxel spacing require careful tuning.
医学适配：降低医学 ViT 从头训练或小数据微调的门槛
Medical Translation: Lowered the barrier for training and fine-tuning Vision Transformers on moderate-sized medical imaging cohorts.
适用边界：训练 recipe 影响巨大；医学域仍需领域预训练与严格外部验证
Evidence Boundary: Established standard ViT training recipes; in-domain medical SSL pretraining still outperforms purely supervised recipes.
医学适配：适配医学检测、分割和高分辨率病理特征金字塔
Medical Translation: Frequently used as a drop-in hierarchical Transformer encoder for polyp, skin lesion, and ultrasound segmentation.
适用边界：奠定层级视觉 Transformer；后续 Swin、MiT 等结构更常用
Evidence Boundary: Pioneered pyramid Vision Transformers; often succeeded by Swin or SegFormer (MiT) in recent pipelines.
自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
Self-Supervised Learning
自监督学习从同一样本的不同视图、teacher–student 一致性、聚类分配或被遮挡内容构造训练目标。医学增强必须保护病灶、患者身份、序列关系和物理强度；目标函数与下游任务所需信息是否一致，比权重规模更重要。

Self-supervised learning constructs supervision from cross-view invariance, EMA teacher–student distillation, online prototype clustering, or masked token reconstruction. Medical augmentations must preserve lesion morphology, patient identity boundaries, multi-sequence relationships, and physical intensity calibration; alignment between the pretraining objective and downstream task granularity outweighs raw model size.
医学适配：医学中推动患者级、多视图和体数据对比学习
Medical Translation: Sparked patient-aware, multi-view, and slice-proximity contrastive learning across radiology and pathology.
适用边界：对比学习基础；医学增强和正负样本定义必须重设
Evidence Boundary: Foundational contrastive SSL paradigm; requires large batch sizes and careful medical augmentation design to avoid false negatives.
医学适配：适合医学小 batch、患者级采样和算力受限 SSL
Medical Translation: Well-suited for compute-constrained 2D/3D medical contrastive pretraining where GPU memory restricts batch size.
适用边界：经典实现；其 momentum/EMA teacher 思想被后续方法继承，queue 本身并非统一模板
Evidence Boundary: Classic contrastive mechanism; its EMA teacher principle directly informed BYOL, DINO, and modern SSL.
医学适配：成为 2D、3D MRI/CT 与病理预训练的基础方法

适用边界：基础设施级 SSL；像素重建可能偏重低层强度
Evidence Boundary: Core SSL infrastructure; pixel-level MSE emphasizes fine texture and intensity, shining brightest under downstream fine-tuning.
医学适配：其 patch 表示直接启发病理和放射 foundation encoder
Medical Translation: Directly underpins pathology tile foundation models (UNI, Virchow) and radiology self-supervised ViTs.
适用边界：DINOv2 的直接祖先；机制与 collapse 控制仍必须理解
Evidence Boundary: Essential precursor to DINOv2; emergent attention maps reflect spatial grouping but should not be over-interpreted as causal proof.
医学适配：成为病理 Phikon、TITAN 等医学 foundation 配方的重要来源
Medical Translation: Core pretraining ingredient in DINOv2, Phikon, UNI, Virchow, and TITAN pathology foundation models.
适用边界：重要训练思想；常与 DINO 系目标组合使用
Evidence Boundary: Highly effective dense + global SSL objective; standardly deployed in tandem with DINOv2 recipes.
医学适配：直接支撑 UNI、Virchow 等病理 foundation encoder
Medical Translation: Forms the direct algorithmic backbone of modern pathology foundation encoders (UNI, Virchow, Prov-GigaPath) and RAD-DINO.
适用边界：强通用特征底座；自然图像域不能自动覆盖灰阶、3D 和微小病灶

医学适配：启发 HeartBEiT 与医学 ViT 的 masked image modeling 预训练

适用边界：非对比 SSL 经典方法；增强策略与域内多样性对医学迁移至关重要

可提示分割：交互式目标定义与纠错
Promptable Interactive Segmentation: Spatial Target Specification & Human-in-the-Loop Refinement
Promptable segmentation 将图像编码与点、框、掩膜提示分离，并由轻量 mask decoder 组合输出，同一图像特征可被反复查询和修正。医学应用集中在标注、交互纠错和候选结构发现；box 依赖、逐切片 3D、一致性、细血管拓扑和域外校准决定其安全边界。

Promptable segmentation decouples heavy image encoding from lightweight point, bounding-box, and mask prompts via a fast two-way attention mask decoder, allowing cached image embeddings to be queried interactively. Clinical utility centers on annotation acceleration, interactive error correction, and specialist adaptation—bounded by box dependency, slice-wise 3D inconsistency, and thin-structure topology.
可提示分割：把固定类别头改造成交互式纠错接口
Promptable Segmentation
医学适配：成为医学交互标注和专科适配的重要底座
Medical Translation: Transformed interactive medical image annotation, semi-automated contour refinement, and specialist adapter development.
适用边界：标注基础设施；原版对低对比、小结构、血管和 3D 不可靠
Evidence Boundary: Annotation infrastructure; zero-shot SAM struggles on low-contrast boundaries, thin branching vessels, and unprompted 3D volumes.
医学适配：用于跨模态交互式医学分割与标注加速
Medical Translation: Standard interactive box-prompted segmentation tool for radiology, oncology, endoscopy, and pathology annotation.
适用边界：强领域适配证据；仍依赖 box prompt，非全自动 3D 终点
Evidence Boundary: Strong domain-adaptation evidence; remains reliant on manual or detector-generated bounding boxes per slice/ROI.
医学适配：适合内镜、超声视频和 CT/MRI 切片提示传播
Medical Translation: Enables rapid interactive propagation of prompts across surgical endoscopy videos, echocardiography, and 3D CT/MRI slice stacks.
适用边界：交互工具潜力高；相邻切片不等于真实 3D 几何
Evidence Boundary: High utility for interactive 3D/video annotation; sequential slice tracking does not replace native 3D volumetric topology priors.
图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义与视觉事实
Vision–Language Alignment & Generative Medical VLMs: Open-Vocabulary Semantics vs. Visual Grounding
CLIP 类双编码器通过图文对比学习共享空间，支持检索、zero-shot 和少标签迁移；BLIP、Q-Former 与 LLaVA 类模型把视觉编码连接到语言模型。全局语义对齐、区域—词语 grounding 和语言生成是不同能力，文本流畅不能证明异常来自图像证据。

CLIP-style dual encoders align images and text in a shared contrastive space for retrieval, zero-shot transfer, and linear probing, whereas BLIP, Q-Former, and LLaVA-style architectures bridge visual tokens into autoregressive LLMs. Global semantic alignment, local phrase–region grounding, and fluent text generation are distinct capabilities; narrative fluency never guarantees visual diagnostic fidelity.
图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
Vision-Language Models

Generative, Diffusion & Flow
VAE 压缩潜变量，GAN 用判别器塑造样本，diffusion/score 学习逐步去噪或分数场，flow matching 与 rectified flow 学习连续速度场，consistency 追求少步映射。医学逆问题还需要 measurement likelihood、forward operator 和定量评价，视觉逼真度不能排除幻觉。

VAEs compress continuous latent manifolds, GANs shape distributions via adversarial discriminators, diffusion/score models learn multi-scale denoising vector fields, flow matching regresses straight ODE transport velocities, and consistency models distill one-step trajectory endpoints. In medical inverse problems, generative priors must be coupled with measurement likelihoods and audited against hallucinations.

物理约束重建：展开优化与测量一致性
Physics-Informed Tomographic Reconstruction: Unrolled Optimization & Measurement Data Consistency
医学重建从 y=A(x)+ε 出发。后处理网络只在图像域修饰初始重建；algorithm unrolling 交替执行 learned prior/proximal 与 A/A* 驱动的数据一致性更新。测量约束能排除明显冲突，但不能证明 null space 中由先验补入的内容属于患者真实解剖。

Medical reconstruction begins from y = A(x) + ε. Whereas image-domain post-processing merely polishes initial analytic reconstructions (FBP/IFFT), algorithm unrolling alternates learned proximal/denoiser priors with explicit A/A* data-consistency updates. While measurement constraints rule out gross data violations, they cannot alone guarantee that null-space features synthesized by the prior reflect true patient anatomy.
物理约束重建：从后处理到展开优化与测量一致性

去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模
Denoising & Image Restoration: Residual Learning, Blind-Spot Self-Supervision & Long-Range Attention
去噪方法依赖 clean/noisy 配对、同一潜在图像的独立噪声对，或 blind-spot/J-invariance 假设。CNN、Swin 与 Restormer 改善空间聚合；缺少 forward operator 时仍属于 image mapping。医学评价还需覆盖病灶保留、纹理/NPS、HU/SUV/ADC 和跨设备剂量泛化。

Restoration networks rely on paired clean/noisy acquisitions, independent noisy realizations of the same anatomy (Noise2Noise), or blind-spot J-invariance assumptions (Noise2Self/Noise2Void). Residual CNNs, SwinIR, and Restormer improve spatial-channel aggregation, but without an explicit forward operator they remain image-space mappings requiring strict audits of lesion contrast, NPS texture, and quantitative HU/SUV preservation.
去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界

Evidence Boundary: Historically influential in low-dose CT denoising; purely image-domain L2 training can still over-smooth low-contrast liver lesions.
医学适配：常用于低剂量 CT、MRI、显微图像去噪与超分辨率迁移
Medical Translation: Widely adopted backbone for MRI super-resolution, low-dose CT/PET denoising, and microscopy image restoration.
适用边界：强恢复 backbone；未显式保证数据一致性或病灶保真
Evidence Boundary: Strong modern restoration backbone; remains an image-space mapping unless embedded inside an unrolled physics data-consistency loop.
医学适配：适合高分辨率病理、CT/MRI 去噪和运动伪影校正
Medical Translation: Well-suited for high-resolution digital pathology restoration, whole-slice MRI motion correction, and low-dose CT denoising.
适用边界：高效 restoration 基线；医学成像算子和不确定性仍需额外约束
Evidence Boundary: Compute-efficient high-resolution Transformer restorer; must be audited for quantitative intensity preservation.
配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
Registration & SE(3)
配准网络从 fixed/moving 图像预测变形场或位姿，再通过 spatial transformer 或 differentiable DRR 形成闭环。粗到细、attention、inverse consistency 与连续坐标表示改善捕获范围或可逆性；评价应同时报告 TRE、表面误差、Jacobian<0、尾部失败率和真实标定误差。

Registration networks predict dense displacement fields or rigid SE(3) poses from fixed/moving pairs, closing the loop via spatial transformers or differentiable DRR ray-casting. Multi-scale pyramids, transformers, gradient inverse consistency (GradICON), and implicit coordinate fields expand capture range and invertibility; evaluation must audit TRE, Jacobian folding, surface accuracy, and calibration sensitivity.
医学适配：成为 VoxelMorph、可微配准和 2D/3D warping 的算子基础
Medical Translation: Provides the foundational differentiable warping operator (`grid_sample`) underlying VoxelMorph and all modern learned medical registration.
适用边界：基础设施；本身不保证变换平滑、可逆或物理合理
Evidence Boundary: Essential differentiable geometry primitive; requires explicit regularization when generalized from low-DOF affine to dense displacement fields.
医学适配：成为 CT/MRI 快速配准最常用的学习式基线
Medical Translation: Foundational fast learning-based baseline for brain MRI, chest CT inspiration–expiration, and longitudinal registration.
适用边界：基础设施级 baseline；跨域、相似度选择和 folding 仍是问题
Evidence Boundary: Core registration infrastructure; simple gradient smoothing does not strictly prevent topological folding (|J_φ| ≤ 0) under large deformations.
医学适配：在多数据集统一 protocol 上提供强通用配准基线
Medical Translation: Provides a highly regular, topology-preserving 3D registration baseline across brain MRI, lung CT, and abdominal scans.
适用边界：比单纯换 encoder 更具长期价值；仍需病理保持和极端域移位验证
Evidence Boundary: Superior theoretical and empirical regularity over raw smoothness penalties; space-occupying tumors without topological correspondence still require special handling.
医学适配：是 registration foundation model 的早期可信实例
Medical Translation: First credible, open-weight foundation model for 3D medical deformable image registration.
适用边界：高速发展；尚未覆盖所有临床域和细结构
Evidence Boundary: Rapidly advancing registration foundation baseline; extreme cross-modality contrasts (e.g., ultrasound-to-MRI) still benefit from domain adaptation.
医学适配：用于术中 X-ray 到术前 CT 的 2D/3D 配准
Medical Translation: Enables accurate intraoperative 2D X-ray to 3D CT registration for orthopedic, spinal, and endovascular image-guided surgery.
适用边界：几何融合范式价值高；标定、散射、金属和外部设备仍会致败
Evidence Boundary: Exemplary hybrid learning + projective physics loop; requires accurate C-arm calibration and robustness to surgical tool occlusion.
医学适配：用于 3D 脑、腹部和胸部 CT/MRI 快速无监督配准
Medical Translation: Widely used benchmark baseline for large-deformation lung CT inspiration–expiration and brain MRI registration.
适用边界：经典 coarse-to-fine 学习式基线；可逆性与拓扑保持仍需额外约束
Evidence Boundary: Classic multi-scale registration architecture; subsequent GradICON/uniGradICON offer stronger inverse-consistency guarantees.
医学适配：成为脑 MRI 和腹部 CT Transformer 配准的常用基线
Medical Translation: Standard Transformer-based 3D medical image registration baseline.
适用边界：重要架构基线；长程 attention 本身不保证拓扑、对称或跨域稳健
Evidence Boundary: Important architectural comparison point; attention in the encoder does not automatically prevent folding without GradICON/diffeomorphic constraints.
医学适配：用于 MRI/CT 个体化配准和连续形变建模
Medical Translation: Used for high-precision lung 4D-CT landmark tracking and patient-specific registration without training datasets.
适用边界：INR 配准代表；逐病例优化较慢且相似度仍可能歧义
Evidence Boundary: Representative implicit neural registration method; per-case optimization takes seconds to minutes rather than milliseconds.
医学适配：为 2D/3D 配准、器械定位和术中导航生成训练数据
Medical Translation: Foundational simulation engine for training intraoperative 2D/3D registration, surgical tool tracking, and pelvic/spinal landmark detection.
适用边界：医学 X-ray 合成基础设施；仿真质量仍取决于扫描与设备标定
Evidence Boundary: Core medical projective simulation infrastructure; fidelity still depends on CT slice thickness and accurate C-arm spectrum modeling.
2D→3D 与神经场：表示、投影一致性和不可辨识性
2D-to-3D Lifting & Neural Fields: Coordinate Representations, Reprojection Consistency & Non-Identifiability
单视图 2D→3D 本质上不可辨识，网络提供的是解剖先验。Voxel、mesh、implicit field 或 Gaussian 表示必须重新投影回观测，并给出多假设或不确定性。NeRF 与 3DGS 用于 X-ray 等医学模态时，需要改写为衰减积分或其他模态特定 forward model。

Single-view 2D-to-3D reconstruction is mathematically ill-posed; networks supply learned anatomical priors rather than hidden CT measurements. Voxel, mesh, implicit neural representation (INR), or 3D Gaussian Splatting representations must enforce physical reprojection consistency and quantify uncertainty, rewriting RGB alpha compositing into Beer–Lambert X-ray attenuation integrals.
2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
2D-to-3D & Neural Fields
医学适配：奠定深度 2D-to-3D CT 生成的历史基线
Medical Translation: Canonical baseline for bi-planar 2D X-ray to 3D CT volumetric lifting.
适用边界：重要但不唯一；逼真纹理不等于患者真实 anatomy
Evidence Boundary: Historically important 2D-to-3D baseline; must never be treated as a diagnostic replacement for true CT acquisition due to null-space hallucination.
医学适配：启发稀疏投影 attenuation fields、内镜场建模和医学 INR
Medical Translation: Catalyzed medical Implicit Neural Representations (INRs), sparse-view CBCT attenuation fields (NAF), and surgical endoscopy scene reconstruction.
适用边界：场表示基础；原始可见光 alpha-compositing 不能直接当 X-ray 物理
Evidence Boundary: Foundational neural field paradigm; visible-light occlusion/emission rendering must be rewritten into Beer–Lambert transmission for X-ray/CT.
医学适配：适用于 phantom/人体 sparse-view CBCT 的自监督 per-case reconstruction；需区分模拟投影与真实 acquisition
Medical Translation: Fast, self-supervised per-patient sparse-view CBCT reconstruction requiring zero external training datasets.
适用边界：正确的医学 NeRF 改写；无外部 prior 时仍不能创造缺失信息
Evidence Boundary: Correct physics adaptation of NeRF to tomography; without an external population prior, extreme view sparsity still exhibits null-space streaks.
医学适配：启发 X-ray radiative Gaussian splatting 和动态 tomography
Medical Translation: Rapidly adapted to surgical endoscopy 3D reconstruction (EndoGaussian) and radiative X-ray Gaussian tomography (R2-Gaussian).
适用边界：实时渲染优势真实；不自动保证 HU、解剖或成像物理
Evidence Boundary: Genuine real-time rendering breakthrough; discrete Gaussian primitives can still produce needle-like artifacts under sparse views.
医学适配：启发 sparse-view X-ray、内镜和解剖场的患者先验建模
Medical Translation: Directly inspires sparse-view dual/single X-ray to 3D CT neural field priors (e.g., PerX2CT, DIF-Net).
适用边界：少视图 NeRF 基础；自然图像辐射假设不能直接替代医学投影物理
Evidence Boundary: Foundational few-view conditional neural field; projective feature occlusion must be adapted for transmission X-ray imaging.
医学适配：加速 CBCT attenuation fields、医学 INR 和配准场优化
Medical Translation: Core acceleration engine inside NAF (CBCT), implicit deformable registration, and real-time surgical scene neural fields.
适用边界：高效坐标编码基础；哈希碰撞和显存参数需按医学分辨率调节
Evidence Boundary: Essential coordinate-encoding infrastructure; high-frequency hash levels can fit measurement noise if not regularized.
医学适配：直接任务是单 X-ray 的 3D-aware projection synthesis；数据增强与表示学习属于潜在用途
Medical Translation: Explored for single-view chest and knee X-ray 3D-aware view synthesis and data augmentation.
适用边界：概念性医学 NeRF；生成投影不等价于患者真实 3D 解剖重建
Evidence Boundary: Conceptual proof-of-concept; synthesized projections reflect a population GAN prior rather than guaranteed patient-specific 3D tomography.
医学适配：用于微创手术场景重建、导航和动态视图合成
Medical Translation: Pioneered neural field 3D soft-tissue reconstruction for DaVinci robotic prostatectomy and minimally invasive surgery.
适用边界：动态内镜 NeRF 早期代表；拓扑变化、镜面反射和临床标定仍困难
Evidence Boundary: Landmark surgical NeRF baseline; cannot handle topological tissue cutting/resection and requires minutes of offline optimization (later accelerated by EndoGaussian).
图神经网络：节点、边与医学拓扑
Graph Neural Networks & Anatomical Meshes: Relational Message Passing & Topological Constraints
GNN 通过邻居消息聚合更新节点状态。血管树、器官 mesh、连接组、细胞图和真实患者事件关系具有天然医学边；任意 kNN patch/patient 图可能编码混杂或数据泄漏，因此需要 graph-free baseline、随机边、替代边消融和真正的 inductive patient split。

GNNs iteratively update node states by aggregating neighborhood messages. Vascular trees, airway branches, cortical surface meshes, connectomes, and spatial cell graphs possess intrinsic physical edges; conversely, heuristic k-NN patient or patch graphs risk encoding batch confounders or transductive leakage, demanding strict graph-free and randomized-edge ablations.
图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息
Graph & Mesh Networks
医学适配：用于 population graph、血管/气道树和解剖 mesh
Medical Translation: Foundational GNN used across brain connectomes (fMRI/DTI), vascular/airway trees, cortical surface meshes, and spatial cell graphs.
适用边界：GNN 基础；深层 over-smoothing 与构图泄漏需警惕
Evidence Boundary: Core GNN baseline; stacking many GCN layers causes over-smoothing, and transductive patient-similarity graphs risk severe cohort leakage.
医学适配：适合血管分支、病人关系和细胞相互作用图
Medical Translation: Widely applied to histopathology cell- microenvironment graphs, brain functional connectivity, and multimodal patient networks.
适用边界：重要图模型；attention 权重不自动等于医学解释
Evidence Boundary: Standard anisotropic GNN; learned attention weights α_{ij} aid inspection but do not guarantee causal biological importance.
医学适配：用于患者相似图、细胞图、血管树和大规模病理图
Medical Translation: Enables scalable inductive training on million-cell whole-slide pathology graphs and dynamic clinical EHR cohorts.
适用边界：归纳 GNN 基础；邻居采样和构图偏差会直接影响医学结论
Evidence Boundary: Essential scalable inductive GNN; uniform random neighbor sampling can miss rare diagnostic hub cells if degree distributions are skewed.
医学适配：适用于分子、细胞相互作用、脑网络和患者关系图
Medical Translation: Excels on molecular property prediction, drug discovery, protein structure, and compact brain region connectome graphs (~100–500 ROIs).
适用边界：图 Transformer 代表；O(N²) 成本和拓扑构造限制大医学图扩展
Evidence Boundary: Leading Graph Transformer; O(N²) all-pair attention and shortest-path computation prohibit direct application to 100,000-node WSI cell graphs.
医学适配：用于心脏、肝脏等器官可解释表面重建
Medical Translation: Produces smooth, genus-zero topological meshes for liver, hippocampus, synaptic junctions, and cardiac chambers.
适用边界：医学 mesh 深度学习代表；固定拓扑难处理孔洞和复杂拓扑变化
Evidence Boundary: Strong explicit 3D surface baseline; fixed sphere topology cannot model organs with holes or variable branching without template modification.
医学适配：用于脑 MRI white/pial cortical surface extraction
Medical Translation: High-speed neuroimaging baseline for cortical thickness analysis, Alzheimer's atrophy tracking, and large biobank processing.
适用边界：显式神经解剖表面强基线；异常 anatomy 与跨扫描协议仍具挑战
Evidence Boundary: Domain-specialized explicit surface landmark; severe brain tumors or strokes that disrupt normal cortical topology remain challenging.
生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练
Temporal Physiological AI
时序架构受采样率、导联或电极身份、事件边界、实时延迟和患者级聚合约束。LSTM/GRU 用门控保留状态，TCN 用因果膨胀卷积建立可计算感受野，Transformer/SSM 处理长依赖，foundation-style 模型利用大规模无标签信号。ECG 导联是不同电场投影，不能等同普通 channel dropout。

Biosignal architectures are governed by sampling frequency, physical lead/electrode geometry, event boundaries, streaming latency, and patient-level aggregation. LSTMs/GRUs maintain gated memory, TCNs build deterministic causal dilated receptive fields, Transformers/SSMs capture long-range dependencies, and foundation models (HeartBEiT, LaBraM, ECGFounder) pretrain across millions of multi-lead recordings.
时间序列 x_1...x_T
Sequential physiological waveform or longitudinal clinical time series x_1 … x_T
医学适配：长期用于小中型 ECG、EEG、EMG 与纵向临床序列
Medical Translation: Long-standing workhorse for 12-lead ECG arrhythmia classification, ICU vitals early-warning scores, and irregular EHR trajectories.
适用边界：仍是低数据序列基线；串行训练慢且长窗口扩展有限
Evidence Boundary: Reliable low-data sequential baseline; sequential step-by-step recurrence prevents parallel training across ultra-long multi-thousand-sample waveforms.
医学适配：成为 ECG/EEG 等生理信号强、便宜、稳定的 baseline
Medical Translation: Highly competitive, fast, and stable baseline for continuous ECG, EEG seizure detection, PPG, and EMG envelope decoding.
适用边界：长期实用；感受野由 dilation/depth 固定且全局自适应关系有限
Evidence Boundary: Practical first-line waveform baseline; receptive field is fixed by network depth/dilation and weights remain static across inputs.
医学适配：提高 ECG 少标签迁移和外部分类表现
Medical Translation: Improves label-efficient transfer for reduced LVEF screening, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and myocardial infarction detection.
适用边界：证明领域预训练价值；渲染、截断和缩放可能损失精确采样、幅值及采集元数据，并依赖固定版式
Evidence Boundary: Demonstrates the power of scale in ECG SSL; rasterizing 1D voltage time series into 2D pixels discards microvolt resolution and ties the model to a fixed plot layout.
医学适配：支持 EEG 分类、检测和 BCI 的迁移与少样本学习
Medical Translation: Canonical foundation model for cross-montage EEG abnormality classification, event detection, and brain–computer interfaces.
适用边界：原论文在四类下游任务报告优势；跨设备、跨人群和独立临床验证仍不足
Evidence Boundary: Significant methodological leap for heterogeneous neurophysiology; clinical cross-hospital sensitivity and false-alarm calibration require ongoing validation.
医学适配：常用于 ECG、EEG、生命体征和纵向临床序列的小数据基线
Medical Translation: Widely used in compact wearable biosignal monitors, GRU-D missing-value clinical EHR time series, and edge medical devices.
适用边界：仍是轻量时序基线；串行计算和超长依赖能力弱于现代并行模型
Evidence Boundary: Lightweight recurrent baseline; like LSTM, remains bottlenecked by sequential step-by-step training on ultra-long sequences.
医学适配：用于心律失常、结构性心脏病和风险预测等 ECG 任务
Medical Translation: High-performing open-weight ECG foundation baseline for arrhythmia diagnosis, structural heart disease screening, and wearable ECG triage.
适用边界：超大规模 ECG FM 代表；设备、群体公平性和前瞻效益仍需验证
Evidence Boundary: Proves that a well-engineered 1D CNN at 10M-sample clinical scale rivals or outperforms complex Transformers; prospective clinical trial validation remains the next frontier.

ZH // 中文原著论述适用边界 新模型的正式发表、作者 benchmark、独立 benchmark、读者研究与前瞻工作流证据不能等同。 参数量、slice/patch/mask 数、FID、SSIM、Dice 或语言流畅度都不足以单独证明临床成熟度。 Data consistency 依赖正确的 operator、coil map、geometry、noise model 与 calibration；错误 forward model 仍可能产生低 residual 的错误解。 临床使用必须结合当地设备、人群、监管、工作流和人工回退重新验证。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTScope Boundaries & Methodological Caveats Peer-reviewed publication, author-reported internal benchmarks, independent external benchmarks, blinded reader studies, and prospective clinical workflow trials represent fundamentally distinct levels of evidence and must never be conflated. Parameter count, pretraining slice/patch/mask volume, FID, SSIM, mean Dice, or linguistic fluency is never sufficient in isolation to establish clinical readiness. Physics-informed data consistency depends on accurate forward operators, coil sensitivity maps, projection geometry, noise models, and scanner calibration; an incorrect forward model can still converge to a low-residual but anatomically erroneous solution. Any real-world clinical deployment requires local re-validation across target scanners, patient demographics, regulatory intended-use boundaries, and human-in-the-loop fallback workflows.

ZH // 中文原著论述结论 卷积、attention 与 selective SSM 分别编码局部先验、全局动态关系和长序列状态压缩，混合结构通常比单一路线更符合医学数据约束。 U-Net 与 nnU-Net 表明，拓扑、空间配置、采样、训练和推理系统共同决定医学性能；单一模块改动很少构成完整范式。 SSL、图文对齐、prompt 与 adapter/LoRA 扩展知识复用，但目标函数、数据单位、患者级去重、外部验证和校准决定实际价值。 重建、配准、2D→3D、导航与生成必须显式处理 forward model、geometry、null space 和 uncertainty；视觉真实感不能替代测量真值。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXTCore Conclusions Convolutions, self-attention, and selective SSMs respectively encode local spatial priors, content-dependent global interactions, and linear-time state compression; hybrid architectures that combine local convolutional stems with global mixers align best with biomedical data constraints. The enduring success of U-Net and nnU-Net proves that information topology, physical spacing configuration, sampling heuristics, training recipes, and inference post-processing jointly govern clinical segmentation performance; isolated block replacements rarely constitute a new paradigm. Self-supervised learning, vision–language alignment, spatial prompts, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (Adapters/LoRA) dramatically expand knowledge reuse, but pretraining objectives, independent patient units, deduplication, external validation, and probability calibration determine real-world utility. Tomographic reconstruction, deformable/2D-3D registration, neural rendering, and generative modeling must explicitly account for physical forward operators, projection geometry, null-space ambiguity, and predictive uncertainty; visual realism can never substitute for measurement ground truth.

二维稠密编码器与解码器特征按切片顺序堆叠，与三维稠密特征融合后送入体积预测头。
2D dense encoder/decoder features are stacked in slice order and fused with 3D dense features before a volumetric head.
合成体积重采样为 32³；嵌入宽度为 8，每级两个模块，窗口为 2³，关闭随机深度。双向结果累积后执行一次优化。原始流分量采用深度、高度、宽度方向的体素位移，由 normalized_xyz_flow 显式转换。

32-cubed resampled synthetic volumes; embedding width8, two blocks per level, 2-cubed windows and no stochastic depth; both directions accumulated into one optimizer step. Raw flow components are D/H/W voxel displacements; normalized_xyz_flow converts them explicitly.
采用完整的 16 像素合成傅里叶采集；缩小层数与卷积核，未执行原始流形预训练或数据增强。
A 16px complete synthetic Fourier acquisition; reduced layer/kernel sizes and no original manifold-pretraining/data augmentation.
三维编码器与解码器预测稠密位移，通过可微形变变换，以图像相似度和空间平滑性联合训练。
A 3D encoder-decoder predicts a dense displacement; image similarity plus spatial smoothness trains through warping.
采用 Beta(N/2,D/2) 径向扰动分布与 EDM 预条件去噪，学习有限维扩展泊松场。
A Beta(N/2,D/2) radial perturbation law and EDM-preconditioned denoising learn the finite-D augmented Poisson field.
SIREN 坐标网络在测试时拟合一对图像的位移，并通过自动微分计算空间导数。
A SIREN coordinate network fits one image pair's displacement at test time with autograd spatial derivatives.
先执行离散平行束斜坡滤波反投影，再由图像域残差 U-Net 细化重建。
A discrete parallel-beam ramp-filtered backprojection precedes residual image-domain U-Net refinement.
完整的潜空间扩散流程需要已学习的第一阶段表征、潜变量缩放和条件扩散模型；本课程没有用像素空间 DDPM 替代它。
A faithful latent-diffusion workflow needs its learned first-stage representation, latent scaling and conditional diffusion model. The pixel-space DDPM lesson is not substituted.
可学习的根节点变换与邻居均值聚合支持归纳式节点预测。
A learned root transform and mean-neighbor aggregation support inductive node prediction.
姿态初始化器与测试时梯度细化共用可微刚性体积投影器。
A pose initializer and test-time gradient refinement share a differentiable rigid volume projector.
仅依赖位置的哈希编码衰减场拟合锥束射线积分观测，透射率遵循比尔–朗伯定律 exp(-integral)。
A position-only hash-encoded attenuation field fits cone-ray line-integral measurements, with Beer-Lambert transmission exp(-integral).
随时间变化的形变把观测映射到标准辐射场；合成遮挡用于屏蔽对应的颜色与深度监督。
A time-dependent deformation maps observations to a canonical radiance field; synthetic occlusions mask RGB/depth supervision.
交替仿射耦合层提供精确逆变换，以及三角雅可比矩阵行列式的精确对数。
Alternating affine coupling layers give exact inverse transforms and exact triangular-Jacobian log determinants.
常规窗口与移位窗口注意力交替执行，配合相对位置偏置及图像块合并。
Alternating regular/shifted window attention, relative position bias and patch merging.
来源审计未确认可访问的完整 MAIRA-1 发布版本。MAIRA-2 是另一模型；仅见于论文的实现细节仍待核实。
An accessible complete MAIRA-1 release was not established in the source audit. MAIRA-2 is a different model. Paper-only implementation details remain unresolved.
本练习只涉及架构；未复现 HeartBEiT 的 DALL-E 标记化、心电图遮挡预训练、预训练权重或心脏下游研究。
Architecture-only exercise: HeartBEiT's DALL-E tokenization, ECG masked pretraining, pretrained weights and cardiac downstream studies are not reproduced.
本练习只涉及架构；未复现向量量化神经标记器、遮挡编码预测、完整预训练语料或 LaBraM 预训练能力。
Architecture-only exercise: VQ neural tokenizer, masked code prediction, full pretraining corpus and pretrained LaBraM capability are not reproduced.
本练习只涉及架构；未包含千万级记录预训练、150 标签诊断体系、导联随机丢弃预训练或已发布检查点。
Architecture-only exercise: no ten-million-recording pretraining, 150-label diagnostic ontology, lead-dropout pretraining or published checkpoint is included.
图谱中的 microsoft/Florence-2 链接返回 404；已核实的原始来源是微软在 Hugging Face 公开的 Florence-2-base。
Atlas GitHub URL microsoft/Florence-2 returned 404. Microsoft's public Hugging Face Florence-2-base release is the verified original source.
图谱中的 bdsp-core/ECGFounder 链接返回 404；根据说明文档与模型卡核实，论文作者的官方实现位于 PKUDigitalHealth/ECGFounder。
Atlas bdsp-core/ECGFounder URL returned 404. The paper authors' official implementation is PKUDigitalHealth/ECGFounder, verified from its README and model card.

Author Kyong Hwan Jin's MATLAB/MatConvNet implementation. The CT acquisition and FBP operator are part of the model's experimental protocol.
作者编码器只处理可见图像块，由轻量解码器重建被遮挡的像素。
Author encoder sees only visible patches; a lightweight decoder reconstructs masked pixels.
来源为作者仓库，图谱原先未提供地址；复制前需核实仓库许可。
Author repository; Atlas had no source URL. The repository license must be checked before copying.
作者的残差因果卷积采用指数增长的空洞率与权重归一化。
Author residual causal convolutions use exponentially increasing dilation and weight normalization.
作者网站提供三维 Caffe 补丁、带或不带批归一化的网络定义、求解器参数和示例权重，并支持 CPU；原始版本不是现代 PyTorch 实现。

Author site supplies the 3D Caffe patch, network definitions with/without batch normalization, solver parameters and example weights. CPU supported; original release is not a modern PyTorch implementation.
作者源码遵循 CC BY-NC-4.0。教学中缩小图像、图像块、宽度与深度，不加载预训练权重；将灰度图重复为三个颜色通道。
Author source, CC BY-NC-4.0. Shrunk image/patch/width/depth; no pretrained weights. RGB obtained by repeating the grayscale teaching image.
采用作者关联的学习专家评估重建 MATLAB/MatConvNet 代码；仓库注明需要 CUDA。
Author-associated MATLAB/MatConvNet code for Learned Experts' Assessment-based Reconstruction. Repository describes CUDA requirement.
采用作者维护的流匹配指南与代码库，发布晚于 2023 年原论文，包含可运行的二维示例，适用 CC BY-NC 条款。
Author-maintained Flow Matching Guide and Code library, released after the original 2023 paper; includes runnable 2D examples. CC BY-NC terms apply.
作者推荐的 DnCNN 代码预测加性噪声残差，再从观测中减去该残差。
Author-recommended DnCNN code predicts the additive noise residual and subtracts it from the observation.
采用作者 Mamba 模块，包括输入相关的 delta/B/C、因果逐通道卷积与精确参考选择性扫描。
Authors' Mamba block, input-dependent delta/B/C, causal depthwise convolution and exact reference selective scan.
采用作者 MedNeXt 编码器、解码器和逐通道倒置瓶颈模块，仅增加本地导入适配器。
Authors' MedNeXt encoder/decoder and depthwise inverted bottleneck blocks, with only a local import adapter.
采用作者 PVT 第一版：四级金字塔、空间缩减注意力，以及最后一级的分类标记。
Authors' PVT v1 class: four pyramid stages, spatial-reduction attention and last-stage class token.
采用作者完整的对角加低秩 S4 核、HiPPO 初始化与快速傅里叶卷积。
Authors' full diagonal-plus-low-rank S4 kernel, HiPPO initialization and FFT convolution.
采用作者重叠式混合 Transformer 编码器、逐通道 Mix-FFN 和全多层感知机多尺度解码头。
Authors' overlapping Mix Transformer encoder, depthwise Mix-FFN and all-MLP multi-scale decode head.
关闭辅助分类器与随机失活；torchvision 文档中的实现细节与原始 Caffe 模型存在差异。
Auxiliary classifiers and dropout disabled; torchvision's documented implementation details differ from the original Caffe model.
BLIP 需要图文对比、匹配和语言建模目标，以及图注生成与过滤流程；此处未实现完整原方法。
BLIP requires the image–text contrastive/matching/language objectives and captioning/filtering workflow; the full original method is not implemented here.
组合双向形变，并惩罚组合误差的空间导数。
Bidirectional warps are composed and the spatial derivative of composition error is penalized.
采用二值图像补全与高斯噪声示例；training_loss 训练先验，reconstruct() 单独执行后验采样。
Binary inpainting and Gaussian noise example; training_loss trains the prior, reconstruct() runs posterior sampling separately.
BiomedGPT 需要统一的多模态标记与序列任务及训练混合；小型通用 Transformer 并未复现这些阶段。
BiomedGPT requires its unified multimodal token/sequence tasks and training mixture. A small generic Transformer does not reproduce these stages.
CONCH 需要病理视觉语言架构及相应目标；CLIP 课程或通用病理分类器均不构成 CONCH 复现。
CONCH requires its pathology vision–language architecture and objectives; neither the CLIP lesson nor a generic pathology classifier is a CONCH reproduction.
使用 CPU PyTorch 实现，不包含融合 CUDA 核、占用跳过或实时性能主张。
CPU PyTorch implementation; no fused CUDA kernels, occupancy skipping or claimed real-time performance.
CPU 教学维度与原论文训练配置不同，具体以显式配置为准。
CPU dimensions differ from the paper's training preset; see the explicit configuration.
采用遵循 Kakao Brain 复现的 Apache-2.0 规范库实现，不是谷歌未发布的原始训练实现或检查点。
Canonical Apache-2.0 library implementation follows the Kakao Brain reproduction; it is not Google's unreleased original training implementation or checkpoint.
采用 Apache-2.0 规范库实现，未复制 Salesforce LAVIS 训练代码。所有模块缩小后随机初始化；冻结的随机 ViT/OPT 不具备预训练视觉或语言知识。

Canonical Apache-2.0 library implementation, not copied Salesforce LAVIS training code. All modules start randomly initialized at reduced dimensions; frozen random ViT/OPT have no pretrained visual or language knowledge.
使用紧凑 U-Net 替代原始 TensorFlow 架构；噪声独立性来自数据假设，不能由图像外观推断。
Compact U-Net instead of the original TensorFlow architecture; independence is a dataset assumption, not inferred from image appearance.
仅实现紧凑瓶颈变体，未复现 nnU-Net 规划器和完整的 U-Mamba_Bot/Enc 训练流程。
Compact bottleneck variant only; nnU-Net planning and the full U-Mamba_Bot/Enc training pipelines are not reproduced.
采用独立紧凑混合移植，未复现分阶段 ImageNet/LiTS 训练、原始 DenseNet 深度及肝脏肿瘤实验。
Compact independent hybrid port; staged ImageNet/LiTS training, original DenseNet depths and liver/tumor experiment are not reproduced.
采用紧凑时间条件 U-Net；默认先验训练使用 1000 个时间索引，祖先采样需要完整 1000 步。
Compact time-conditioned U-Net; default prior training uses 1000 time indices, and ancestral generation requires all 1000 steps.
条件最优传输高斯路径与解析速度回归，在训练时无需求解常微分方程。
Conditional optimal-transport Gaussian path and analytical velocity regression require no training-time ODE solve.
会议页面标注 MICCAI 2026；仓库当前版本日期为 2026-09-25，预印本记录日期为 2026-10-07。说明文档引用中的 2027 与这些记录不一致，不应据此视为新模型发布。

Conference page dates the work to MICCAI 2026; repository HEAD is dated 2026-09-25 and the arXiv record is dated 2026-10-07. The README BibTeX uses 2027; do not treat that inconsistent field as a new model release.
采用连续方差保持边缘加噪与去噪分数匹配；逆向随机微分方程与概率流常微分方程使用不同的分数系数。
Continuous VP marginal noising and denoising score matching; reverse SDE and probability-flow ODE have different score coefficients.
坐标与方向条件的密度、辐射通过排他透射率和发射吸收合成完成积分。
Coordinate/direction-conditioned density and radiance integrate using exclusive transmittance and emission-absorption compositing.
跨视图学生教师蒸馏，教师采用停止梯度的指数移动平均，并对教师概率执行中心化与锐化。
Cross-view student–teacher distillation with stopped EMA teacher, centering and sharpened teacher probabilities.
采用 DINO 式全局与遮挡图像块蒸馏，并加入最近邻熵正则项。
DINO-style global and masked patch distillation with a nearest-neighbor entropy regularizer.
DeepDRR 包含标定几何、材料分解、散射与物理成像。本实验的可微简化射线投影器不等同于 DeepDRR。
DeepDRR includes calibrated geometry, material decomposition/scatter and physical image formation. The differentiable toy ray projectors here are not a DeepDRR replacement.
默认运行 VGG-16，设置 variant=19 可运行 VGG-19。使用 1×1 自适应池化和窄分类器替代原始输出头。
Default runs VGG-16; set variant=19 for VGG-19. Adaptive pooling 1x1 and narrow classifier replace the original head.
默认快速检查采用第一轮校正流；迭代重流需要另行生成端点并重新训练。
Default smoke training is first-round rectified flow; iterative reflow requires user-run endpoint generation and retraining.
默认教师是根据合成形状填充率定义的解析分类器，不是论文中的预训练 RegNetY；真实教师可通过 teacher_logits 提供。
Default teacher is an explicit analytic classifier of synthetic shape fill ratio, not the paper's pretrained RegNetY. Supply teacher_logits for a real teacher.
使用包含 16 个高斯的稠密 CPU 光栅化器，不包含 CUDA 分块渲染、增密、剪枝或非常数球谐函数。
Dense CPU rasterizer with sixteen Gaussians; no CUDA tile renderer, densification, pruning or nonconstant spherical harmonics.
直接采用上游 DenseNet 类中的稠密拼接和压缩过渡层。
Dense concatenation and compressed transition layers in the upstream DenseNet class.
稠密传感器到图像层学习全局复数傅里叶域到图像的变换，再执行卷积细化。
Dense sensor-to-image layers learn a global complex Fourier-to-image transform, followed by convolutional refinement.
采用逐通道 7×7 卷积、通道后置层归一化、倒置瓶颈与层缩放。
Depthwise 7x7 convolution, channels-last LayerNorm, inverted bottleneck and layer scale.
采用确定性置零与紧凑 U-Net；完整的 J 不变推理需要九次前向计算。
Deterministic zero replacement and a compact U-Net; full J-invariant inference needs nine forward passes.
通过 Tweedie x0 估计对观测差异求导，再引导连续的 DDPM 采样更新。
Differentiate measurement discrepancy through the Tweedie x0 estimate, then guide consecutive DDPM sampling updates.
直接使用 PyG GATConv，在小图上设置两层、两个注意力头，不主张达到论文基准。
Direct PyG GATConv; two heads/two layers on small graphs. No paper benchmark claim.
直接使用 PyG GCNConv，以独立采样的小图替代引文或医学数据集。
Direct PyG GCNConv; independently sampled small graphs replace citation/medical datasets.
直接使用 PyG SAGEConv，在微型图上使用全部邻居，替代大图随机采样。
Direct PyG SAGEConv; uses all neighbors on tiny graphs instead of stochastic large-graph sampling.
直接使用 PyTorch GRU，其重置门位于循环线性映射之后；Cho 等人的原始公式将其放在之前，因此不主张与原公式逐位等价。
Direct PyTorch GRU applies reset after the recurrent linear map; the Cho et al. original formulation places it before. Not claimed bitwise equivalent to that original equation.
直接使用现代 PyTorch LSTM，包含 1997 年论文之后引入的遗忘门。合成波形不是心电或脑电数据。
Direct modern PyTorch LSTM includes forget gates introduced after the 1997 paper; this historical difference is explicit. Synthetic waves are not ECG/EEG.
每个阶段结合独立的三层卷积正则器与显式转置投影残差。
Each stage combines its own three-layer CNN regularizer with an explicit A-transpose projection residual.
每个求解采用八次共轭梯度迭代；使用三次展开和合成笛卡尔双线圈数据。
Eight CG iterations approximate each solve; three unrolls and synthetic Cartesian two-coil data.
采用编码器解码器多头注意力、正弦位置编码、因果目标掩码，以及教师强制标记损失。
Encoder-decoder multihead attention, sinusoidal positions, causal target mask and teacher-forced token loss.
一个视图的熵正则平衡 Sinkhorn 分配监督另一视图的原型分数。
Entropy-regularized balanced Sinkhorn assignments from one view supervise prototype scores in the other.
使用非零奇异值为 1 的严格对角二值图像补全算子；未提供具有实用能力的预训练先验。
Exactly diagonal binary inpainting operator with unit nonzero singular values; a useful pretrained prior is not supplied.
FCN-8s 组合 VGG 的 pool3/pool4 分数融合与可学习的 2 倍、2 倍、8 倍转置上采样。
FCN-8s: VGG pool3/pool4 score fusion plus learned 2x/2x/8x transposed upsampling.
扩展维度取有限值 D=64，使用紧凑网络。原始 PFGM 对应 D=1，而非 D 趋于零的极限；未包含完整常微分方程采样器。
Finite augmented dimension D=64 and compact network; original PFGM corresponds to D=1, not a D-to-zero limit; no full ODE sampler.
采用有限差分雅可比与小型共享网络，未包含原始多步配准架构，也不提供拓扑保证。
Finite-difference Jacobians and a small shared network; no original multistep registration architecture or topology guarantee.
采用 torchvision 的五个卷积层与三个全连接层，并缩小分类器。
Five convolution layers and three fully connected layers from torchvision; reduced classifier.
五通道原始域与对偶域记忆在每个阶段由独立卷积网络、显式算子 A 及其精确转置共同更新。
Five-channel primal and dual memories update through distinct CNNs and explicit A and its exact transpose at every stage.
采用固定 16 级一致性训练网格与均方误差，未进行预训练扩散蒸馏或原始渐进调度。

采用缩小的 U-Net 与像素驱动教学投影器，不是原始 MatConvNet/CT 几何实现。
