使用缩小的 U-Net、已知合成平移与归一化坐标，未使用预训练 VoxelMorph 或微分同胚积分。
Reduced U-Net, known synthetic translations and normalized coordinates; no pretrained VoxelMorph or diffeomorphic integration.
缩减 VGG 通道与全连接宽度；同尺寸填充替代原始填充与裁剪边界约定。
Reduced VGG channels/FC widths; same-padding replaces the original padding/cropping boundary convention.
缩减通道并使用同尺寸填充；稠密标注体模未复现稀疏标注研究。
Reduced channels; same-padding; densely labelled phantoms do not reproduce the sparse-annotation study.
缩小宽度与深度并随机初始化，用 32 标记合成词表和两对图像替代网络规模噪声图文训练。保留 EfficientNet 全部七类阶段，每级至少一个模块。

Reduced width/depth with random initialization, 32-token synthetic vocabulary and two paired images replace web-scale noisy image-text training. All seven EfficientNet stage types remain; each has at least one block.
由第一份含噪采集回归第二份独立、未截断、零均值含噪采集；损失函数不读取干净数据。
Regress a second independent unclipped zero-mean noisy acquisition from the first; clean data is not read by the loss.
回归直线噪声到数据路径的速度；reflow_pairs 显式重新配对已训练常微分方程的起点与终点样本。
Regress straight noise/data path velocities; reflow_pairs explicitly recouples a trained ODE's initial and terminal samples.
用 A 的伪逆作用于 y 的结果替换估计 x0 的观测值域分量，同时保留零空间分量。
Replace estimated x0's measurement-range component with A-dagger y while retaining its null-space component.
仓库默认分支为第二版，而图谱论文对应 PVT 第一版；应使用匹配的原始架构，两版不能互换。
Repository default branch is v2, while the Atlas paper is PVT v1. Use the matching original PVT architecture; PVTv2 is not interchangeable.
直接从 torchvision 实例化 ResNet-18 基本残差阶段。
ResNet-18 BasicBlock residual stages, directly instantiated from torchvision.
采用残差卷积 U 形编码器与解码器，在展平的瓶颈特征上加入作者 Mamba 模块。
Residual convolution U-shaped encoder/decoder with authors' Mamba block on flattened bottleneck features.
通过恢复局部打乱、贝塞尔强度变换、图像补全或外部补全后的三维输入进行训练。
Restore 3D inputs after local shuffling, Bezier intensity transformation, inpainting or outpainting.
SAM2 需要分层图像编码器、记忆编码与注意力，以及视频提示状态协议；SAM1 适配器不提供这些功能。
SAM2 requires its hierarchical image encoder, memory encoder/attention and video prompt/state protocol; these are not provided by the SAM1 adapter.
采用 SE-ResNet-18 家族示例而非 SENet-154，设置单通道输入与三个类别。
SE-ResNet-18 family example, not SENet-154; one-channel input and three classes.
分别计算判别器与非饱和生成器梯度，实现双人博弈。
Separate discriminator and non-saturating generator gradients implement the two-player game.
保留 17 个卷积层，宽度从 64 减为 8，不加载预训练权重。
Seventeen convolution layers retained, width reduced from 64 to 8; no pretrained weights.
采用共享输出头的双视图机制练习，简化掩码采样与编码器，未包含原始训练调度或权重。
Shared-head two-view mechanism exercise; simplified mask sampler/encoder and no original training schedule or weights.
相邻噪声尺度对共享噪声，采用停止梯度的指数移动平均目标，以及精确的最小噪声尺度边界参数化。
Shared-noise adjacent sigma pairs, a stop-gradient EMA target, and exact sigma_min boundary parameterization.
采用单个参考视图、小型编码器与多层感知机和合成场景，不包含原始 ResNet 编码器或多视图特征聚合。
Single reference view, small encoder/MLP and synthetic scenes; no original ResNet encoder or multiview feature aggregation.
采用单进程日志适配器，以朴素 CPU 柯西核替代加速核，并增加小型分类器。
Single-process logging adapter; naive CPU Cauchy kernel instead of accelerated kernels; small classifier added.
采用小型多层感知机生成器与判别器，仅执行一次同时更新，而非调优后的对抗训练调度。
Small MLP generator/discriminator; one simultaneous update instead of a tuned adversarial training schedule.
以小型卷积像素解码器替代多尺度可变形注意力；目标为语义前景和背景，而非全景实例标注。
Small convolution pixel decoder replaces multi-scale deformable attention; semantic foreground/background targets, not panoptic instance annotations.
采用小型自定义网络与合成正交均值投影，不是原始胸部 CT 模型，且需要两个视图。
Small custom encoders/decoder, synthetic orthogonal mean projections; not the original chest-CT model, and two views are required.
采用小型自定义网络与位移复合，不是原始拉普拉斯残差特征解码器或微分同胚变体。
Small custom networks and displacement composition; not the original Laplacian residual-feature decoder or diffeomorphic variant.
采用小型滤波器组与三个阶段；合成平滑线圈图直接提供，不通过学习得到。
Small filter bank and three stages; synthetic smooth coil maps are supplied, not learned.
以小型图像块 Transformer 替代原始 ResNet，采用灰度合成增强，未执行 ImageNet 规模批次或训练。
Small patch Transformer replaces the original ResNet; grayscale synthetic augmentations; no ImageNet-scale batch/training.
小的正最小噪声尺度使端点保留平滑；这里采用条件最优传输路径，不代表全部流匹配变体。
Small positive sigma_min leaves endpoint smoothing; this is the conditional OT path, not every flow-matching variant.
采用小规模双视图实验，未包含多裁剪队列或分布式训练。微型批次用于目标函数练习，不能证明迁移表征已经学成。
Small two-view experiment; no multi-crop queue/distributed training. Tiny batches are an objective exercise, not evidence of learned transfer.
以小词表与标记反转练习替代机器翻译，未执行 WMT 训练方案。
Small vocabulary and token reversal exercise instead of machine translation; no WMT training recipe.
压缩重排、数据初始化 ActNorm、可逆 1×1 混合与仿射耦合共同提供精确似然和逆变换。
Squeeze, data-initialized ActNorm, invertible learned 1x1 mixing and affine coupling provide exact likelihood and inversion.
对称卷积与反卷积堆栈通过镜像加性特征跳连和残差图像路径传递信息。
Symmetric convolution/deconvolution stacks carry mirrored additive feature skips and a residual image path.
加入自环后执行对称度归一化邻居聚合。
Symmetrically degree-normalized neighbor aggregation with added self-loops.
任务为合成二维对齐而非分类，仿射网格使用归一化坐标，不以患者毫米计量。
Synthetic 2D alignment rather than classification; affine grid coordinates are normalized, not patient millimetres.
合成通道编号 1..C 不代表解剖电极身份；真实脑电需明确检查导联配置、通道顺序、单位与采样。
Synthetic channel IDs 1..C have no anatomical electrode identity. Real EEG requires explicit montage, channel-order, unit and sampling checks.
合成灰度图重复为三个颜色通道，以 32 标记教学词表替代字节对标记化；文本结束编号 2 显式映射到原始 CLIP 池化所需的最大标记编号。

Synthetic grayscale images are repeated into RGB. A 32-token teaching vocabulary replaces byte-pair tokenization; EOS=2 is explicitly remapped to the largest token ID required by original CLIP pooling.
仅使用合成教学数据，不主张临床有效性或达到已发布基准。
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
使用合成词表替代原始标记器。视觉初始化与可学习查询标记采用标准差 0.02 的正态分布，避免面向检查点的近零或零默认值；不主张具备图像描述或问答能力。

Synthetic vocabulary replaces the original tokenizer. Vision initialization and learned query tokens use normal std=0.02 to avoid the library checkpoint-oriented near-zero/zero defaults. No image-captioning or question-answering capability is claimed.
合成波形插值为每通道两个 200 样本图像块，仅用于形状适配，不表示真实脑电采样率，也不增加信息。
Synthetic waveforms are interpolated to two 200-sample patches per channel. This is a shape adapter, not an assertion of EEG sampling rate or a source of extra information.
TITAN 使用完整切片级视觉文本表征流程；此处未复现原始训练阶段或预训练能力。
TITAN uses a complete slide-level visual/text representation pipeline; original training stages and pretrained capabilities are not reproduced here.
教学标记器为固定图像块强度量化，不是预训练离散变分自编码器。仅演示离散目标函数，不主张与 BEiT 架构或结果等价。
Teaching tokenizer is fixed patch-intensity quantization, NOT the pretrained dVAE tokenizer. Demonstrates the discrete-target objective only; no claim of BEiT architecture or result equivalence.
默认教学训练提供一个前景点并执行两轮提示，未复现 11 轮混合点框调度、噪声框、大规模数据引擎或原始优化器调度。

Teaching training uses an initial supplied foreground point and two prompt rounds by default. The 11-round mixed point/box schedule, noisy boxes, large-scale data engine and original optimizer schedule are not reproduced.
使用十层、小通道，并在每隔一层深度设置简化跳连；不是完整 RED30 架构或训练。
Ten layers, small channels and simplified every-second-depth skips; not the full RED30 architecture/training.
参考文献是 2016 年 RED-Net 图像恢复论文。尚未核实官方源码仓库，不应替换为无关的 2018 年 RGB-D RedNet 分割模型。
The 2016 RED-Net restoration paper is the reference. An official source repository has not yet been verified; do not substitute the unrelated 2018 RGB-D RedNet segmentation model.
2023 年论文的代码可用性章节将该作者仓库列为模型创建来源；代码公开不等于预训练权重可用。
The 2023 paper's Code availability section links this author repository for model creation. Code availability does not establish availability of pretrained weights.
图谱论文及当前微软、Hugging Face 检索未确认可访问的 MAIRA-1 发布版本。MAIRA-2 是另一模型，不能替代；论文移植应明确尚未解决的细节。

The Atlas paper and current Microsoft/Hugging Face searches did not establish an accessible MAIRA-1 release. MAIRA-2 is a different model and is not substituted. A paper-based implementation must state all unresolved details.
本 CPU 教学运行器尚未集成 CHIEF 的病理图块、切片表征与临床上下文流程。
The CHIEF pathology tile/slide representation and clinical-context workflow are not integrated into this CPU teaching runner.
此处尚未实现或验证 LLaVA-Med 的视觉投影器、语言主干和两阶段医学指令调优。
The LLaVA-Med visual projector, language backbone and two-stage medical instruction tuning are not implemented or validated here.
尚未集成 MAIRA-2 的图像报告定位与语言生成流程，模型卡和访问条款仍以上游为准。
The MAIRA-2 image/report grounding and language generation pipeline is not integrated; the published model-card/access terms remain upstream.
尚未集成 Merlin 三维影像与临床文本预训练流程；随机三维分类不等于 Merlin。
The Merlin 3D imaging and clinical-text pretraining pipeline has not been integrated; random 3D classification is not Merlin.
尚未复现 UNI 预训练病理表征、数据及训练方案；本仓库许可不替代上游 CC BY-NC-ND 条款。
The UNI pretrained pathology representation and data/training recipe are not reproduced. The upstream CC BY-NC-ND terms are not replaced by this repository license.
使用具有作者微软 MIT 声明的 BEiT 分类编码器，输入光栅化合成波形；保留相对位置偏置、层缩放与标记均值池化。
The author's MIT-attributed BEiT classification encoder receives rasterized synthetic traces; relative position bias, layer scale and mean token pooling are retained.
作者链接仓库包含 CheXpert 图文检索评估表，而非 ConVIRT 模型或训练代码。模型实现应以论文为源；独立社区实现不是作者代码。

The author-linked repository contains CheXpert image/text retrieval evaluation CSVs, not ConVIRT model or training code. Treat the paper as the model implementation source. Independent community implementations exist but are not author code.
采用作者 Net1D：同尺寸填充的分组一维瓶颈、压缩激励、残差下采样、全局时间池化与任务头。
The authors' Net1D: SAME-padded grouped 1D bottlenecks, squeeze-excitation, residual downsampling, global time pooling and a task head.
作者 TemporalConv 与 NeuralTransformer 处理通道与时间分块，分别使用可学习电极、时间嵌入及查询键归一化。
The authors' TemporalConv and NeuralTransformer operate on channel-by-time patches with separate learned electrode and time embeddings and Q/K normalization.
未复现完整 BLIP-2 两阶段方案及预训练的冻结编码器与语言模型。
The complete BLIP-2 two-stage recipe and pretrained frozen encoders/language model are not reproduced.
当前 CPU 实验室尚未实现完整图块编码器、切片级长上下文聚合与原始预训练阶段。
The complete tile encoder plus slide-level long-context aggregation and original pretraining stages are not implemented in the present CPU lab.
当前仓库包含 nnU-Net 第二版，而所链接的 Nature Methods 论文描述早期系统；复现原方法前应选择匹配论文的分支和配置。
The current repository contains nnU-Net v2; the linked Nature Methods paper describes the earlier system. Select the paper-matched branch/configuration before claiming original-method reproduction.
默认读取单通道合成波形，不是生理心电图，也不是经验证的单导联疾病预测器。
The default reads one synthetic waveform channel; it is not a physiological ECG or a validated single-lead disease predictor.
默认将四条无量纲合成波形绘制在 64×64 网格上；它们不是生理心电图或经过标定的纸质心电图。
The default uses four dimensionless synthetic waveform traces rendered on a 64x64 grid; these are not physiological ECGs or calibrated paper ECG images.
尚未实现该模型特有的局部与全局放射图文对齐，以及完整报告预处理与训练流程。
The defining local/global radiology image–text alignment and complete report preprocessing/training workflow are not implemented here.
已确认的作者发布内容包含评估材料，而非经过完整核实的 ConVIRT 训练实现；图文编码器、配对采样和完整预训练方案仍需按论文实现。

The identified author release contains evaluation material, not a complete verified ConVIRT training implementation. The image/text encoders, pair sampling and full pretraining recipe still need a paper-based implementation.
BioViL 官方实现在微软 hi-ml 中；当前 CPU 实验室尚未集成其图像编码器、临床语言模型或原始预训练阶段。
The official BioViL implementation is in Microsoft hi-ml. Its image encoder, clinical language model and original pretraining stages have not been integrated into this CPU lab.
PhyDiCT 官方推理源码可访问且已固定版本。尚未在本地适配或执行其 MedSyn 三维扩散预训练先验、报告嵌入、标定投影几何、LPIPS 引导和面向 CUDA 的采样。合成数据库用于源码学习，不构成 PhyDiCT 重建实验。

The official PhyDiCT inference source is available and pinned. Its pretrained MedSyn 3D diffusion prior, report embedding, calibrated projection geometry, LPIPS guidance, and CUDA-oriented sampling have not been adapted or executed locally. The synthetic database supports source study only; it is not a PhyDiCT reconstruction experiment.
已链接并固定原始 BME-X 实现；尚未将完整多模态学习流程转换为经过测试的低资源适配器。
The original BME-X implementation is linked and pinned; its complete multimodal learning workflow has not been converted into a tested low-resource adapter.
原始 DnCNN 说明明确推荐同一作者的 PyTorch KAIR 实现；网络位于相应模型模块并依赖基础模块，须保留 Kai Zhang 的 MIT 声明。
The original DnCNN README explicitly recommends the same author's PyTorch KAIR implementation. DnCNN is in models/network_dncnn.py and depends on models/basicblock.py; retain Kai Zhang's MIT notice.
已链接并固定原始 MARS 实现；其特有预训练和下游流程尚未在此集成测试。
The original MARS implementation is linked and pinned; its defining pretraining and downstream workflow have not been integrated and tested here.
保留原始 MedSAM 的 [0,1] 输入约定。合成灰度图重复为三个颜色通道，紧致真值框替代原始随机扰动训练框与医学预处理。

The original MedSAM [0,1] input convention is retained. Synthetic grayscale is repeated into RGB; supplied tight boxes replace the original randomly perturbed training boxes and medical preprocessing.
已链接并固定原始 Prima 实现；扫描及序列表征和完整训练推理协议尚未本地实现。
The original Prima implementation is linked and pinned; its scan/series representation and complete training/inference protocol are not implemented locally.
尚未集成或检查原始 VISTA3D 点与类别条件三维架构及预训练流程。
The original VISTA3D point/class-conditioned 3D architecture and pretrained workflow have not been integrated or checked here.
未复现原始大规模 ALIGN 噪声配对预训练方案或权重。
The original large-scale ALIGN noisy-pair pretraining recipe and weights are not reproduced.
论文代码可用性章节列出 DINOv2、Hugging Face BERT 训练与 OpenCLIP 组件，并注明 Decipher-MR 预训练权重可能无法共享。尚未核实完整发布版本，这些框架本身不是 Decipher-MR；论文移植仍需方法与补充细节。

The paper's Code availability section names DINOv2, Hugging Face BERT training and OpenCLIP components, and states pretrained Decipher-MR weights may not be shared. No complete release is verified here; those frameworks are not a Decipher-MR release. Methods and supplementary details remain necessary for a paper-based implementation.
尚未实现或检查预训练分数先验、三维或二维半重建流程，以及完整 DiffusionMBIR 数据一致性程序。
The pretrained score prior, 3D/2.5D reconstruction workflow and full DiffusionMBIR data-consistency procedure have not been implemented or checked.
提示编码器按作者训练脚本保持冻结。返回交并比分数供检查，但 MedSAM 的 Dice 加二元交叉熵目标不训练这些分数；不使用临床数据，也不主张临床性能。
The prompt encoder stays frozen as in the author training script. IoU scores are returned for inspection but are not trained by MedSAM's Dice+BCE objective. No clinical data or performance claim.
通用 CLIP 课程不包含已发布 BiomedCLIP 架构、生物医学标记器或预训练流程，也未内置其权重。
The published BiomedCLIP architecture, biomedical tokenizer and pretraining workflow are not supplied by the generic CLIP lesson. No BiomedCLIP weights are bundled.
根目录源码采用 Apache-2.0，但这不能确定所有依赖、检查点或数据集各自的条款。此处未再分发第三方代码或临床数据。

The root source-code license is Apache-2.0; this does not settle the separate terms of all bundled dependencies, model checkpoints or datasets. No third-party code or clinical data is redistributed here.
相同 DDPM 噪声目标驱动独立非马尔可夫采样器；eta=0 时，在初始噪声给定条件下生成过程确定。
The same DDPM epsilon objective feeds a separate non-Markovian sampler; eta=0 is deterministic conditional on initial noise.
来源审计未确认 MedCLIP 根目录许可授权，因此未推定复制权限，也未在此重新实现其语义匹配目标与编码器。
The source audit did not establish a root license grant for MedCLIP. No permission to copy was inferred; its semantic-matching objective and encoders are not reimplemented here.
三顺序扫描是教学类比，不是作者 BiMamba-v3 或快速切片内核，也不是完整 SegMamba 架构。
The three-order scan is a pedagogical analogue, not the authors' BiMamba-v3/fast-slice kernel or complete SegMamba architecture.
GradICON 机制示例未提供 uniGradICON 基础配准模型或其训练分布。
The uniGradICON foundation registration model and training distribution are not supplied by the GradICON mechanism demonstration.
上游仓库已归档；尝试原始流程前应固定并隔离旧版依赖。
The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

本课程运行分割架构，未复现原始旋转、对比、恢复自监督预训练或其检查点。
This lesson runs the segmentation architecture. The original SSL rotation/contrast/restoration pretraining and its checkpoint are NOT reproduced.
三个由粗到细的配准阶段对既有估计执行形变，并复合残差位移修正。
Three coarse-to-fine registration stages warp previous estimates and compose residual displacement corrections.
使用三级池化与同尺寸填充，替代原始四级无填充卷积及裁剪配置。
Three pooling levels and same-padding instead of the original four-level valid-convolution/crop preset.
采用三个残差块，不包含历史缓冲或长期学习率调度，仅进行合成域转换。
Three residual blocks; no replay buffer or long-horizon learning-rate schedule; synthetic domain translation only.
采用三个分辨率层级、宽度 8、MONAI 实现与合成前景类别。
Three resolution levels, width 8; MONAI implementation and synthetic foreground classes.
三种谱域逆向更新情形，依据含噪观测与零或非零奇异值对扩散先验施加条件。
Three spectral reverse-update cases condition a diffusion prior on noisy measurements and zero/nonzero singular values.
以三个阶段与 16 像素平行束体模替代完整 ODL 实验。
Three stages and a 16px parallel-beam phantom replace the full ODL experiment.
采用三次展开与像素驱动平行束算子，通过 softplus 缩放约束正步长参数。
Three unrolls and a pixel-driven parallel-beam operator; positive step parameters are bounded through softplus scaling.
采用三级窄网络独立移植，未复现原始剪枝、临床实验或 nnU-Net 训练器。
Three-level, narrow independent port; original pruning/clinical experiments and nnU-Net trainer not reproduced.
TorchVision 是维护中的库实现，不是 2012 年作者原始训练版本。其 AlexNet 不同于原始双 GPU 与局部响应归一化架构，因此不能称为论文数值复现。

TorchVision is the maintained library implementation, not the original 2012 author training release. Its AlexNet definition differs from the original dual-GPU/local-response-normalization architecture; do not call it a numerical reproduction of the paper.
torchvision 使用其文档中的 AlexNet 变体，以 1×1 自适应池化和宽度 128 分类器替代原始 6×6 与 4096 输出头。
Torchvision uses its documented AlexNet variant; adaptive pooling 1x1 and classifier width 128 replace the 6x6/4096 head.
Transformers 的 ALIGN 基于 Kakao Brain 复现。Kakao 模型卡说明谷歌未发布原始代码，且该模型使用 COYO 数据，不是谷歌原始检查点。
Transformers implements ALIGN using the Kakao Brain reproduction. Kakao model card says Google's original code was not released and this model uses COYO data. Not the original Google checkpoint.
十二层 ViT 编码器提取中间标记特征，再由体积 U 形网络解码。
Twelve-layer ViT encoder with intermediate token features decoded by a volumetric U-shaped network.
在小图像像素上运行两个 Transformer 模块，不使用预训练潜空间变分自编码器；原始代码适用 CC BY-NC 4.0，而非 MIT。
Two Transformer blocks on small image pixels; no pretrained latent VAE. Original code is CC BY-NC 4.0, not MIT.
在像素上运行两个模块，不包含预训练变分自编码器、其他分数或噪声参数化及随机微分方程采样器。
Two blocks on pixels; no pretrained VAE or alternative score/noise parameterizations and SDE samplers.
使用两级级联、更小宽度与四条标定线，以合成体模均方误差替代原始基准训练损失与数据。
Two cascades, smaller widths and four calibration lines; synthetic phantom MSE replaces the original benchmark training loss/data.
以两个紧凑限制玻尔兹曼机替代论文的大型四层示例；默认前两次训练调用用于预训练，之后用于微调。
Two compact RBMs replace the paper's large four-layer example; default first two training calls pretrain and later calls fine-tune.
每个尺度执行两次卷积，结合收缩路径、转置上采样与编码器跳连拼接。
Two convolutions per scale, contracting path, transposed upsampling and concatenated encoder skips.
采用两个独立视图、非线性投影与对称 NT-Xent，排除自相似项。
Two independent views, nonlinear projection and symmetric NT-Xent; self-similarities excluded.
两个正交图像编码器沿缺失轴提升特征，三维融合联合使用对抗、体素与投影损失。
Two orthogonal image encoders lift features along their missing axes; 3D fusion uses adversarial, voxel and projection losses.
采用两级、每级两个模块，嵌入通道为 24、窗口为 4 像素；仅执行去噪任务，不提供预训练超分辨模型。
Two two-block stages, 24 embedding channels and 4px windows; denoising task only, no pretrained super-resolution model.
缩小维度但不修改 Apache-2.0 MedSAM 架构，以随机初始化替代 SAM/MedSAM 检查点。这是合成数据上的微调机制演示，而非预训练医学模型。

Unmodified Apache-2.0 MedSAM architecture at reduced dimensions. Random initialization replaces SAM/MedSAM checkpoints; this is the fine-tuning mechanism on synthetic data, not a pretrained medical model.
不修改作者 Apache-2.0 架构，仅缩小图像、宽度和深度并随机初始化；不包含 MAE 初始化、SA-1B 预训练，也不主张零样本性能。
Unmodified Apache-2.0 author architecture at reduced image size/width/depth with random initialization; no MAE initialization, SA-1B pretraining, or zero-shot performance claim.
不修改作者 MIT 架构，仅缩小维度并随机初始化；不提供预训练权重，也不主张完成基础模型预训练。
Unmodified MIT author architecture with smaller dimensions and random initialization; no pretrained weights or foundation-pretraining claim.
采用未修改的作者 TemporalConvNet，设置三个小通道阶段和新任务头，使用合成波形，不主张论文基准结果。
Unmodified author TemporalConvNet with 3 small channel stages and a new task head. Synthetic waves; no paper benchmark.
更新门与重置门控制循环状态，不设置独立记忆单元状态。
Update and reset gates control recurrent state without a separate cell state.
采用上游 GoogLeNet 多分支 Inception 模块与全局池化。
Upstream GoogLeNet multi-branch Inception modules and global pooling.
采用上游 MBConv、压缩激励与复合宽度深度配置。
Upstream MBConv, squeeze-excitation and compound width/depth configuration.
将上游 ResNet 瓶颈类配置为分组三乘三变换，基数为 8。
Upstream ResNet Bottleneck class configured with grouped 3x3 transforms (cardinality 8).
采用上游 VGG-16 的 D 配置构建层，缩减通道并使用三层分类器。
Upstream make_layers with the VGG-16 D configuration, reduced channels and three-layer classifier.
仅实现方差保持分支与欧拉积分，未重建原始预测修正网络或已发布配置。
VP branch and Euler integration only; original predictor-corrector networks and published settings are not recreated.
采用向量化单尺度耦合、均匀去量化与小型多层感知机，不包含原始多尺度图像架构。
Vectorized single-scale coupling, uniform dequantization, small MLPs; no original multiscale image architecture.
通用 DINOv2 机制课程未复现 Virchow 预训练病理表征及其数据与训练协议。
Virchow pretrained pathology representations and their data/training protocol are not reproduced by the generic DINOv2 mechanism lesson.
Virchow 公开访问条款标注 Apache-2.0，并说明负责任使用指南不意在限制该许可证赋予的权利；托管方仍要求机构注册。
Virchow's public gate text identifies Apache-2.0 and says its responsible-use guidelines are not intended to restrict Apache rights. Institutional registration is still requested by the host.
视觉初始化标准差设为 0.1，替代面向检查点的 0.02，以避免未经校准的深随机图像塔在评估时下溢。合成图像采用 [-1,1] 归一化，不使用原始数据增强，尚未证明基础检索或零样本性能。

Vision initializer std=0.1 replaces the library's checkpoint-oriented 0.02, whose deep uncalibrated random tower can underflow during evaluation. Synthetic images use [-1,1] normalization without original data augmentation; no foundation retrieval or zero-shot performance is established.
采用体积卷积、池化、上采样及同尺度三维编码器跳连，并使用批归一化。
Volumetric convolution/pooling/upsampling and same-scale 3D encoder skips with BatchNorm.
Vox2Cortex 需要皮层表面拓扑、体积特征采样、耦合网格细化与损失。这些尚未在 CPU 实验室实现，仍保留原始 GPL 源码链接。
Vox2Cortex requires cortical surface topology, volumetric feature sampling and coupled mesh refinement/losses. These have not been implemented in this CPU lab; original GPL source remains linked.
Voxel2Mesh 需要可变形网格初始化、图卷积细化、自适应反池化与网格损失；图分类课程不能替代这些流程，仍保留原始 GPL 源码链接。

Voxel2Mesh needs its deformable mesh initialization, graph-convolution refinement, adaptive unpooling and mesh losses. The graph classification lessons are not substitutes; the original GPL source remains linked.
以宽度 100、深度 2 替代原始基础配置，全部权重随机初始化。
Width 100 and depth two replace the original base preset; all weights are random.
宽度为 4，每尺度一个模块，扩展率为 2、卷积核为 3；未复现原始缩放、训练或 UpKern 实验。
Width 4, one block per scale, expansion 2 and kernel 3; original scaling/training/UpKern experiment is not reproduced.
宽度为 8，在 64 像素上执行五次 U-Net 下采样；默认示例为合成含噪与干净配对图像。
Width 8 and five U-Net downsamplings at 64px; default examples are synthetic noisy/clean pairs.
宽度为 8，每级一个模块，不加载预训练恢复权重。
Width 8 and one block per level; no pretrained restoration weights.
缩小宽度、深度与图像块大小；随机权重不具备基础模型能力。
Width/depth/patch size are reduced; random weights carry no foundation-model capability.
